document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. WIDE AFRICAN LANDSCAPE - MORNING
document_metadata.summary: The sun rises over a savanna, shifting colors to blood red, emitting red lightning and thunder as credits appear; snow falls on the burning landscape by the final credit.

chunks.content: At first only darkness, then the rising sun paints in an endless savanna from horizon to horizon. We hear savage drums beating in the distance coming from some unknown place. The sun clears the horizon. Suddenly it changes amazingly: the white disc goes through a rapid series of color transitions, from yellow to green to purple to an incredible BLOOD RED. From it shoots a RED LIGHTNING BOLT. The sky echoes with THUNDER. We hear a HOWLING ethereal wind, but not a twig of the brush stirs as bolt after bolt of RED LIGHTNING rips the sky, with each one a TITLE or CREDIT appearing. Under FINAL CREDIT snow is beginning to fall on the burning blood-red savanna.

document_metadata.title: 2、EXT. PLANE IN FLIGHT - DAY
document_metadata.summary: A Twin Otter aircraft with a commuter airline logo flies over calm countryside under a clear, serene sky filled with white clouds.

chunks.content: I's a Twin Otter with the logo of some commuter airline. It buzzes along over pleasant countryside, through a sky that's almost unnaturally serene and filled with fleecy white clouds.

metadata.title: 2、EXT. PLANE IN FLIGHT - DAY
metadata.summary: A Twin Otter aircraft with a commuter airline logo flies over calm countryside under a clear, serene sky filled with white clouds.

document_metadata.title: 3、INT. PLANE IN FLIGHT - DAY
document_metadata.summary: The plane jolts violently, startling Dale as she looks out at clouds; Flash stands in the cockpit doorway talking to the pilots.

chunks.content: There are just two passengers in the cabin. One is DALE ARDEN, a great looking dark-haired girl sitting by herself and reading a book entitled \"KARATE FOR THE SINGLE GIRL.... A Guide to Survival In The City.\" A few rows forward, near the open door into the pilots' compartment, is FLASH GORDON. He's studying a football play-sheet, one of those diagrammed things with X's and 0's for the players and dotted-line arrows indicating the directions of movement.

metadata.title: 3、INT. PLANE IN FLIGHT - DAY
metadata.summary: The plane jolts violently, startling Dale as she looks out at clouds; Flash stands in the cockpit doorway talking to the pilots.

chunks.content: Suddenly the plane makes a violent bump. It almost knocks the book from DALE'S hand. She looks out the window with sudden fright, tossing hair out of her eyes, in a gesture that's habitual to her in moments of stress. There's nothing to see outside but the pretty clouds. She looks forward again and watches FLASH standing up easily, leaning in the cockpit doorway to speak to the PILOTS.

metadata.title: 3、INT. PLANE IN FLIGHT - DAY
metadata.summary: The plane jolts violently, startling Dale as she looks out at clouds; Flash stands in the cockpit doorway talking to the pilots.

document_metadata.title: 4、INT. PLANE/ COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The plane experiences violent turbulence; FLASH worries about missing training camp but is told by DALE to stop distracting the overwhelmed pilots during the crisis.

chunks.content: FLASH asks the crew about a sudden jolt, and the PILOT dismisses it as clear-air turbulence, nothing serious. The CO-PILOT lightens the mood with a joke about not wanting to throw a third-down pass through the turbulent air, then requests an autograph from FLASH for his child. FLASH agrees cheerfully and begins to accept the paper the CO-PILOT offers, showing his friendly and approachable nature despite the circumstances.

metadata.title: 4、INT. PLANE/ COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS
metadata.summary: The plane experiences violent turbulence; FLASH worries about missing training camp but is told by DALE to stop distracting the overwhelmed pilots during the crisis.

chunks.content: Suddenly, the plane lurches again, more violently than before, interrupting the moment. The PILOT reacts with concern, instructing someone to contact Westchester Approach for updates. FLASH expresses worry about possibly turning back, emphasizing how important it is for him to arrive on time for the first day of training camp. As he starts returning to his seat, another sharp jolt shakes the aircraft, forcing him to grab onto something for balance.Struggling to stay upright, FLASH suggests they might find smoother air at a higher altitude. Before the crew can respond, DALE sharply interrupts, telling him to shut up. FLASH turns in surprise at the sudden outburst, and DALE continues, explaining that the pilots are already overwhelmed—urging FLASH to stop distracting them and just let them fly the plane.

metadata.title: 4、INT. PLANE/ COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS
metadata.summary: The plane experiences violent turbulence; FLASH worries about missing training camp but is told by DALE to stop distracting the overwhelmed pilots during the crisis.

document_metadata.title: 5、INT. PLANE - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: Dale, a travel agent who hates flying, accepts a candy bar from Flash mid-flight; she panics as the plane appears to move backward, noticing the clouds shifting strangely.

chunks.content: The plane buffets. FLASH is sent reeling, catches hold of the rack above DALE, lowers himself into the seat next to her. He buckles fast, takes out a candy bar and offers it to her. FLASH: When you're nervous, it can help to chew on something. DALE: Thanks a lot -- I look dumb enough to take candy from a stranger? FLASH: I'm not a stranger exactly -- You know my name. DALE: Who doesn't. Number one draft pick, cover of PEOPLE mag -- what'd the GIANTS sign you for, eighty-nine million? Big deal!

metadata.title: 5、INT. PLANE - CONTINUOUS
metadata.summary: Dale, a travel agent who hates flying, accepts a candy bar from Flash mid-flight; she panics as the plane appears to move backward, noticing the clouds shifting strangely.

chunks.content: FLASH: Of course. DALE: God, I hate flying -- I'm Dale Arden it's crazy of me to hate flying -- I'm a travel agent, you see? -- I've just been checking out a little hotel in Vermont -- can I still have that candy bar? (and in the same breath) Are we going backward? FLASH: Backwards? DALE: (GASP) Holy cow! Look at the clouds!

document_metadata.title: 8、EXT. A FANTASTIC GREENHOUSE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: A decaying antique greenhouse stands isolated in a scenic landscape, topped by a glass tower with a reflective object inside; red sun and fast-moving clouds loom overhead as a man moves on a platform halfway up, surrounded by floating helium balloons.

chunks.content: It is a huge and rambling, antique, standing in semiruinous isolation in a pretty country landscape. The sun has turned . the SAME BLOOD RED we saw from the airplane, and clouds race across it with unnatural velocity. In the center of the greenhouse rises a glass-paned tower through which we glimpse something MIRROR BRIGHT. Floating high in the air above the structure are several silvery helium- filled balloons, secured by wires. As we move closer, we discern a MAN moving about actively on a platform inside the central tower, about half-way up:

document_metadata.title: 9、INT. GREENHOUSE TOWER - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Dr. Zarkov, convinced Earth's weather crisis is a deliberate attack, prepares to launch a spacecraft with his reluctant assistant Munson, using a revolver to force compliance after the TV explodes.

chunks.content: The man is DR. HANS ZARKOV: big, bearded, feverish looking and seemingly half mad with exhaustion. In striking contrast to the antique greenhouse exterior, here there are all kinds of computers and displays connected together in a slapdash fashion. Quantities of neglected plants, most brown and dead or dying, hide the works in here from outside view. As Zarkov runs around throwing switches and eyeing displays, a grim-voiced TV. NEWSMAN is appearing and speaking from a good-sized television screen above the main control console: TV NEWSMAN The extraordinary weather disturbances reported from Africa this morning are now crossing the Atlantic, and are expected to reach the East Coast of the United States by noon. According to scientists at NASA, the Earth is being struck by an immense stream of cosmic energy, apparently the result of some catastrophic stellar accident beyond the reaches OF -- ZARKOV whirls, slams the TV SOUND OFF and yells at the silently mouthing NEWSMAN on the screen. ZARKOV Fools! Can't you understand? This is no accident-- it's an ATTACK! An attack planned by a MIND! This is ATTACK!

metadata.title: 9、INT. GREENHOUSE TOWER - DAY
metadata.summary: Dr. Zarkov, convinced Earth's weather crisis is a deliberate attack, prepares to launch a spacecraft with his reluctant assistant Munson, using a revolver to force compliance after the TV explodes.

chunks.content: MUNSON, a scared looking assistant, comes running up the stairs with a computer print-out sheet. MUNSON Dr. Zarkov! Look at the report from the last balloon! ZARKOV grabs it, eyes it. . ZARKOV I predicted it, didn't I? MUNSON Yes, sir -- you sure did. And this funny sun too --- ZARKOV Ozone layer starting to crack up. By tonight Carbon dioxide will be combining with free nitrogen to form -- (breaks off, crumpling THE SHEET) Well, this is it. MUNSON Sir, the President is on the TV behind YOU -- ZARKOV What the hell do I care? I tried to warn him -- he called me mad, like all the others. BOOM! The TV screen EXPLODES in a fine shower of glass. ZARKOV (CONT'D) Time for us to go, Munson. Get your toothbrush and whatever. MUNSON Go where? ZARKOV Up. Up and at him.Stunned, MUNSON turns his head and glances at something big and MIRROR BRIGHT gleaming behind foliage in center of tower. MUNSON You're crazy! Perfectly calm except for the maniacal glint in his eyes, ZARKOV pulls out a revolver and points it at MUNSON. ZARKOV I can't handle the capsule alone get your toothbrush.

metadata.title: 9、INT. GREENHOUSE TOWER - DAY
metadata.summary: Dr. Zarkov, convinced Earth's weather crisis is a deliberate attack, prepares to launch a spacecraft with his reluctant assistant Munson, using a revolver to force compliance after the TV explodes.

document_metadata.title: 10、INT. COCKPIT TO SKY - POV
document_metadata.summary: Pilots encounter surreal cloud formations and intense red lightning, causing cockpit systems to fail amid blinding flashes and crackling noises as they attempt an emergency landing.

chunks.content: The PILOTS watch these clouds also, transfixed with disbelief. They speak with that incredible calmness characteristic of professional airmen in a moment of impending catastrophe. PILOT asks, 'What's the word from Westchester Approach, Bill?' The CO-PILOT replies, 'Zip. All channels dead.' Reacting to the panel, he adds, 'Say, get a load of the VOR's.... The directional needles are going crazy. All the instruments are going crazy.' Displays flash impossible symbols. The PILOT gapes at them a moment, then returns his gaze to the sky and swallows.

metadata.title: 10、INT. COCKPIT TO SKY - POV
metadata.summary: Pilots encounter surreal cloud formations and intense red lightning, causing cockpit systems to fail amid blinding flashes and crackling noises as they attempt an emergency landing.

chunks.content: On the left, about six o'clock high, the racing stream of clouds is parting open like in some surreal painting. From the cortex, LASER-like bolts of RED LIGHTNING shoot out. Like a missile, one zaps right over the plane's nose with a horrible crackling NOISE. PILOT (CONT'D) shouts, 'Hold on tight, let's put baby down right here......' The CO-PILOT reaches up and hits the flap control. There is a whooshing crackling ZAP! The whole cockpit FLARES OUT with an intolerable blinding flash of RED LIGHT.

metadata.title: 10、INT. COCKPIT TO SKY - POV
metadata.summary: Pilots encounter surreal cloud formations and intense red lightning, causing cockpit systems to fail amid blinding flashes and crackling noises as they attempt an emergency landing.

document_metadata.title: 11、INT. PASSENGER CABIN - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: The cockpit door flies open, wind scatters papers, and FLASH unbuckles and rushes forward.

chunks.content: The cockpit door flys off its hinges, admitting a gale of wind that scatters FLASH'S play sheets like autumn leaves. FLASH unsnaps his belt, leaps up and races forward.

metadata.title: 11、INT. PASSENGER CABIN - CONTINUOUS
metadata.summary: The cockpit door flies open, wind scatters papers, and FLASH unbuckles and rushes forward.

document_metadata.title: 12、INT. COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: As the plane dives toward Earth, Flash and Dale exchange a tense joke; a greenhouse appears below amid near-miss red lightning strikes, the windshield shattered as they struggle to regain control.

chunks.content: (DALE, FLASH) The TWO PILOTS are gone, vanished without trace. Wind from the shattered windows assaults FLASH as he charges in. He stumbles forward as the plane noses into a dive. Recovering he scrambles into the left-hand seat, grabs hold of the bucking wheel yoke, pulls back and kicks at the rudder pedals. DALE lurches in against the tornado. DALE Can you fly it? FLASH I can fly all right -- I've had a couple of lessons! -- just don't if I can land! FLASH (CONT'D) (FIGHTING CONTROLS) Grab that other wheel! Help me pull her up! DALE staggers into the co-pilot's seat, pulls back on the wheel in front of her.

metadata.title: 12、INT. COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS
metadata.summary: As the plane dives toward Earth, Flash and Dale exchange a tense joke; a greenhouse appears below amid near-miss red lightning strikes, the windshield shattered as they struggle to regain control.

chunks.content: DALE Oh boy! Ever hear about the man who fell ninety stories from a window and didn't break a bone? FLASH No but I'd sure like to! How'd The man fall ninety stories didn't break a bone? DALE The window was ninety-one stories up!SHOOTING FORWARD - THROUGH THE BROKEN WINDSHIELD The Earth is approaching fast, wheeling and tilting. We get a glimpse of a strange greenhouse structure at the end of a flat area. Another barrage of crackling RED LIGHTNING BOLTS shoot all around the plane but just miss it.

metadata.title: 12、INT. COCKPIT - CONTINUOUS
metadata.summary: As the plane dives toward Earth, Flash and Dale exchange a tense joke; a greenhouse appears below amid near-miss red lightning strikes, the windshield shattered as they struggle to regain control.

document_metadata.summary: FLASH warns of an imminent action targeting a field ahead.

chunks.content: (FLASH) FLASH Brace yourself I'm aiming at that field up ahead!

document_metadata.title: 14、EXT. ZARKOV'S GREENHOUSE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Zarkov, under a red sun, threatens Munson with violence, demanding he come out or be shot, amid explosions of glass and foliage.

chunks.content: (ZARKOV'S VOICE) Its thousands of panes reflect the RED SUN and the RED BOLTS which rain down in intermittent bursts. One strikes an end of a gallery, exploding glass and foliage. From inside, we HEAR a furious echoing VOICE: ZARKOV'S VOICE I see you, Munson! Come out or I shoot! .

metadata.title: 14、EXT. ZARKOV'S GREENHOUSE - DAY
metadata.summary: Zarkov, under a red sun, threatens Munson with violence, demanding he come out or be shot, amid explosions of glass and foliage.

document_metadata.title: 15、INT. GREENHOUSE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: MUNSON rejects ZARKOV's plea and walks away; ZARKOV aims his revolver but hesitates, distracted by an external threat, abandoning the shot.

chunks.content: ZARKOV stands on the lower stairs of the tower, revolver in hand, his voice tense with urgency. MUNSON emerges from a patch of dry brown bushes where he had been hiding, defiant and resigned. He questions the point of risking his life, whether by bullet or by joining ZARKOV’s mission, since he believes he’s doomed either way. ZARKOV concedes the danger but appeals to a higher cause—that MUNSON’s sacrifice could give Earth a chance at survival. He challenges MUNSON’s courage and spirit, urging him to rise to the moment.

metadata.title: 15、INT. GREENHOUSE - DAY
metadata.summary: MUNSON rejects ZARKOV's plea and walks away; ZARKOV aims his revolver but hesitates, distracted by an external threat, abandoning the shot.

chunks.content: MUNSON, unmoved, bids ZARKOV a cold farewell, remarking that people were right about the doctor all along, and sarcastically wishes him a pleasant journey. Without hesitation, he turns and walks toward the door at the end of the long side wing, his steps deliberate and final. ZARKOV calls after him, desperate now, insisting he cannot remove the device alone and pleading for MUNSON to reconsider. His voice rises in frustration: 'If you won’t come, who will I find?'MUNSON continues walking, ignoring the cries behind him. ZARKOV raises his revolver and takes aim at MUNSON’s back, his finger tightening on the trigger. Just as he prepares to fire, something in the distance catches his attention. He freezes, reacting to an unseen presence or event outside, his focus abruptly shifting from MUNSON to the new threat or development beyond the tower.

metadata.title: 15、INT. GREENHOUSE - DAY
metadata.summary: MUNSON rejects ZARKOV's plea and walks away; ZARKOV aims his revolver but hesitates, distracted by an external threat, abandoning the shot.

document_metadata.title: 16、EXT. GREENHOUSE
document_metadata.summary: A Twin Otter crashes into a greenhouse during a rough landing, burying Munson under the wreckage as he attempts to flee.

chunks.content: Amazingly, a Twin Otter is gliding in to a horribly rough landing in the field outside. The plane hits on one wheel, bounces into the air, comes down again and keeps right on rolling toward the greenhouse. AS ABOVE - FEATURE MUNSON SEEING the onrushing plane, freezing an instant then starting to run. He hardly gets five yards before the Twin Otter comes SLAMMING IN through the greenhouse wall, burying MUNSON totally under the wreckage.

metadata.title: 16、EXT. GREENHOUSE
metadata.summary: A Twin Otter crashes into a greenhouse during a rough landing, burying Munson under the wreckage as he attempts to flee.

document_metadata.title: 17、INT. COCKPIT - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Flash and Dale escape a wrecked cockpit; Dale is injured but alive, expressing admiration for Flash as they exit before the ship explodes.

chunks.content: (DALE, FLASH) Crazily angled, filled with dust and smoke. Dazed, blood on his forehead, FLASH struggles from his seat. . FLASH Dale! Are you all right? DALE I'm terrific. (WEAK SMILE) Flash Gordon, you have just made me a Giant fan for life. FLASH Come on -- let's get out before she blows! FLASH helps her from the wrecked seat, wheels and kicks out the emergency exit in the cockpit area.

metadata.title: 17、INT. COCKPIT - DAY
metadata.summary: Flash and Dale escape a wrecked cockpit; Dale is injured but alive, expressing admiration for Flash as they exit before the ship explodes.

document_metadata.title: 18、INT. GREENHOUSE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Zarkov pulls a gun, forcing Flash and Dale to run upstairs as Earth is attacked by red laser bolts; Flash plans to wait for an escape opportunity.

chunks.content: FLASH lowers DALE to the ground, jumps down after her. ZARKOV is there, smiling at them in a strange way. FLASH: Hello. I'm Flash Gordon, this is Miss Dale Arden -- ZARKOV (MEANS IT): Delighted to see you. FLASH: This crazy storm knocked us down, could we use a phone? ZARKOV: Certainly. Just follow me -- up those stairs. FLASH: Some weather, huh? ZARKOV: It will get worse. ZARKOV turns and smiles at them again as they start up the tower stairs. Suddenly DALE stops short, staring at ZARKOV with a funny expression. DALE: You're Dr. Hans Zarkov! ZARKOV hesitates just an instant, then nods. ZARKOV: How did you know? DALE: I saw you in PEOPLE mag. After you left NASA, remember? It said you were utterly --- DALE breaks off, almost biting her tongue. ZARKOV: Insane? Off my rocker? DALE: I forget what it said: (TURNING HASTILY) Flash, let's find some other phone, okay? I'm sure Dr. Zarkov is very busy.......

metadata.title: 18、INT. GREENHOUSE - DAY
metadata.summary: Zarkov pulls a gun, forcing Flash and Dale to run upstairs as Earth is attacked by red laser bolts; Flash plans to wait for an escape opportunity.

chunks.content: FLASH is baffled, but he gets her urgent look. FLASH: Well, all right -- but it seems to me we ought to -- Now it's FLASH'S turn to break off. ZARKOV is pointing a gun at him. ZARKOV: Up the stairs to the tower! Ahead of me -- quick! -- (as they gape at him, FROZEN) Quick I said: We haven't much time -- Earth is being attacked! -- there's only one slim chance of saving it! FLASH: Mister, you are insane! HOWL of ether-wind increases. Storm of RED LASER BOLTS. Glass showers them as parts of the green house EXPLODE and dry foliage bursts into FLAME. ZARKOV: Up the stairs -- RUN! ZARKOV jabs the revolver into DALE'S back. RED BOLTS zap around. FLASH whispers to her as they start running up ahead of ZARKOV. FLASH: Go with the flow -- wait for a chance!Below them, bottom of staircase disintegrates in a RED FLASH.

metadata.title: 18、INT. GREENHOUSE - DAY
metadata.summary: Zarkov pulls a gun, forcing Flash and Dale to run upstairs as Earth is attacked by red laser bolts; Flash plans to wait for an escape opportunity.

document_metadata.title: 19、INT. TOP LEVEL OF GREENHOUSE TOWER
document_metadata.summary: Zarkov plans a suicidal mission to destroy a mysterious enemy in space, forcibly takes Dale and Flash into the capsule, and launches despite their resistance.

chunks.content: ZARKOV rips away a screen of foliage, revealing a MIRROR BRIGHT capsule, seamless but for one door. He yanks that open. On every side things are blowing up and burning under the merciless rain of bolts. One strikes the capsule head on, but does not even leave a mark. ZARKOV I need your help to take off! Get in or I shot you dead! DALE gasps and shrinks back.

metadata.title: 19、INT. TOP LEVEL OF GREENHOUSE TOWER
metadata.summary: Zarkov plans a suicidal mission to destroy a mysterious enemy in space, forcibly takes Dale and Flash into the capsule, and launches despite their resistance.

chunks.content: FLASH Take off for where? ZARKOV God only knows -- whatever black corner of space this is coming from -- wherever HE is! We'll plunge into the devil's heart and destroy him! We'll die ourselves, of course, but our names will be honored till the end of time! DALE Look, Doc -- I don't book kamikaze tours -- never.FLASH is poised to jump, but ZARKOV suddenly pushes DALE off-balance, INTO the capsule. FLASH leaps after her.

metadata.title: 19、INT. TOP LEVEL OF GREENHOUSE TOWER
metadata.summary: Zarkov plans a suicidal mission to destroy a mysterious enemy in space, forcibly takes Dale and Flash into the capsule, and launches despite their resistance.

document_metadata.title: 20、INT. CAPSULE
document_metadata.summary: Flash and Dale are pressed together by intense G-forces as Zarkov, struggling in the spinning capsule, declares his mission was built on friendship and warns of Earth's impending doom.

chunks.content: It is curiously transparent from the inside, mirrored only on the exterior. There are some controls and displays, but in general the interior is severely ascetic: as far removed from conventional spacecraft as ZARKOV's solitary genius is from everyday science. Immediately starting to set switches in a frenzy of activity, ZARKOV waves the gun at FLASH. ZARKOV Sit down there! Foot on the red pedal! DALE Flash! Sack him! . ZARKOV wheels and pulls the door shut. FLASH jumps him. He punches ZARKOV in the gut. ZARKOV slams him back with the well-known strength of a madman. FLASH clobbers him again. Falling, ZARKOV dives sidewards and hits a switch. The capsule WHINES SOFTLY and begins to WHIRL. Looking out through the transparent wall, it is as if the capsule itself was motionless and the scene outside is whirling. What's left of the greenhouse is under a constant rain of those LASER BOLTS, flashing fire that makes us dizzy.

metadata.title: 20、INT. CAPSULE
metadata.summary: Flash and Dale are pressed together by intense G-forces as Zarkov, struggling in the spinning capsule, declares his mission was built on friendship and warns of Earth's impending doom.

chunks.content: FLASH staggers to his feet and finds DALE, folds his arms around her protectively. The centrifugal force is rapidly increasing now, throws them both against the wall. Faster and faster, whirling, the force presses DALE'S body back against FLASH'S until they are almost one flesh. We move over and find ZARKOV plastered against another part of the whirling capsule, his face drained white and distorted by the terrific G-Force operating here now, his lips moving as he speaks with enormous effort: ZARKOV, Friendship...Built this to send to them in...Friendship...The end now...End of the world....Unless we

metadata.title: 20、INT. CAPSULE
metadata.summary: Flash and Dale are pressed together by intense G-forces as Zarkov, struggling in the spinning capsule, declares his mission was built on friendship and warns of Earth's impending doom.

document_metadata.summary: A mirror-bright capsule emerges from an exploding tower, rising and accelerating into the sky.

chunks.content: Totally ablaze within now, one huge fantastic jewel of fire. The whole central tower explodes outward. From the inferno a MIRROR-BRIGhT capsule slowly rises, hovers, begins picking up speed again as it ascends.

metadata.title: 21、EXT. GREENHOUSE - LONG SHOT (MINIATURE)

document_metadata.title: 22、EXT. CAPSULE IN FLIGHT
document_metadata.summary: An object whirls unharmed through space, deflecting repeated laser bolts while accelerating away.

chunks.content: Whirling, whirling, invincibly unharmed by the LASER BOLTS which glance off it again and again, accelerating up into space.

metadata.title: 22、EXT. CAPSULE IN FLIGHT
metadata.summary: An object whirls unharmed through space, deflecting repeated laser bolts while accelerating away.

document_metadata.title: 23、EXT. CAPSULE IN FLIGHT - POV
document_metadata.summary: Jupiter's massive storm and deep methane clouds, Saturn's icy rings, and the outer planets pass by as the solar system recedes into the distance.

chunks.content: The EARTH recedes below into a ball, RED-HUED' under the fantastic sun. A fast approaching light FLARES up against the mirrored surface and is recognised as our MOON. It flashes past, follows EARTH into e distance. All around, the sky darkens into the void of space. FANTASTIC MONTAGE - OUTER PLANETS OF OUR SOLAR SYSTEM . They hurtle past the capsule in rapid sequences: RED MARS A sudden gauntlet of careening ASTEROIDS, all sizes, from tiny zingers to one almighty tumbler big as AFRICA.

metadata.title: 23、EXT. CAPSULE IN FLIGHT - POV
metadata.summary: Jupiter's massive storm and deep methane clouds, Saturn's icy rings, and the outer planets pass by as the solar system recedes into the distance.

chunks.content: Mammoth JUPITER with thirteen moons and its atmosphere of deadly methane clouds more than 1000 miles deep. The RED PATCH on its surface is a storm 20,000 miles across which has raged without intermission for 200 EARTH centuries. Through the RINGS OF SATURN in a dazzling LIGHTSTORM of blazing ice crystals.NEPTUNE, PLUTO, outermost URANUS. One after another the planets are left hurtling behind, wheeling in their concentric orbits, the entire SOLAR SYSTEM dwindling into nothing.

metadata.title: 23、EXT. CAPSULE IN FLIGHT - POV
metadata.summary: Jupiter's massive storm and deep methane clouds, Saturn's icy rings, and the outer planets pass by as the solar system recedes into the distance.

document_metadata.summary: The Capsule moves at immense speed through a vast nebula, highlighting its scale and velocity as it passes through.

chunks.content: It tilts and wheels wondrously as the Capsule passes through the middle of it. Considering that this Nebula is probably a million light-years from edge to edge, we get some notion of the Capsule's speed.

metadata.title: 24、EXT. A SPIRAL NEBULA
metadata.summary: The Capsule moves at immense speed through a vast nebula, highlighting its scale and velocity as it passes through.

document_metadata.title: 25、EXT. A BLACK HOLE IN SPACE
document_metadata.summary: A capsule and light rays from a galaxy curve and vanish into a void due to extreme gravitational forces.

chunks.content: Curving light-rays from another galaxy are drawn fantastically together and then simply DISAPPEAR as they are pulled in by the unimaginable gravitation force of is THING. we SEE the CAPSULE, tiny, curving, and spinning along amidst the mind- blowing display of light rays, sucked along with them then simply DISAPPEARING as it too enters the void.

metadata.title: 25、EXT. A BLACK HOLE IN SPACE

document_metadata.title: 26、EXT. CAPSULE IN FLIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Ming and Klytus observe survivors on a screen, with Ming deciding to delay their execution to study them first.

chunks.content: (KLYTUS, MING) Visible again, gleaming in an AMBER GLOW. Suddenly a dancing grid of lines appears OVER IT, making us realise that we must be SEEING IT on some kind of screen. It BLURS out of focus, comes back again more sharply as some adjustment has apparently been made. ECU - EYES OF MING THE MERCILESS Deep in shadow, gleaming with evil amusement. MONTAGE - ECU'S OF MING'S FACIAL FEATURES Curve of lip, flare of nostril, fold of eyelid, gleam of shaven scalp, each a menacing landscape of sensual shadow as WE HEAR: MING (O.S.) They survived our Black Hole -- . KLYTUS (O.S.) Hail Ming! Shall I drown them in the Sea of Fire? MING (O.S.) Later, Klytus -- I think we will look at them first.

metadata.title: 26、EXT. CAPSULE IN FLIGHT

document_metadata.title: 27、INT. CAPSULE - SHOOTING FROM WITHIN
document_metadata.summary: Zarkov fails to stop the capsule's descent; it narrowly avoids destruction, passes through purple vapor, and enters a new landscape, descending into a sea of high grass.

chunks.content: Through the transparent walls as the spinning motion is rapidly SLOWING DOWN. The three voyagers are crumpled on the floor against the wall in strange attitudes, FLASH'S arms still holding DALE. They seem semi-conscious, as if dropped. An AMBER GLOW bathes them, and soon we see its source. A huge planet wheels into view through the transparent wall. It is MONGO. Its curved surface is a pure sea of AMBER FIRE molten lava, with great tongues of flame erupting horrifically. ZARKOV blinks, struggles to focus his eyes. He succeeds, with horror SEES where they are headed.

metadata.title: 27、INT. CAPSULE - SHOOTING FROM WITHIN
metadata.summary: Zarkov fails to stop the capsule's descent; it narrowly avoids destruction, passes through purple vapor, and enters a new landscape, descending into a sea of high grass.

chunks.content: Making a choking sound, ZARKOV stirs and tries to crawl over to a control panel. He pushes switches. Nothing happens. The CAPSULE keeps on going down. A great leaping tongue of fire licks it. Suddenly, just as destruction seems imminent, the capsule miraculously changes its flight path and soars above the remaining flames. It races through them. A shadow passes over MONGO as the CAPSULE passes through a wall of PURPLE VAPOR and emerges above a totally different landscape.A dozen VARIOUS COLORED CLOUDS sweep past in silent majesty. The CAPSULE slows, hovers starts straight down into a sea of high grass.

document_metadata.title: 28、EXT. MONGO -- GRASSY AREA - EVENING
document_metadata.summary: Against a vivid sunset, the shimmering city of Mongo rises with golden tiers and towers as armored men observe a descending mirror-bright capsule and move toward it.

chunks.content: In the distant B.G. against an extraordinary SUNSET SKY, rises the shimmering CITY OF MONGO.... a place of many levels, golden tiers and turrets, towers, flags and pennants. It is like something dreamed. Several STRANGELY ARMORED MEN watch the MIRROR-BRIGHT CAPSULE descending slowly. The LEADER waves and they all start toward the CAPSULE.

metadata.title: 28、EXT. MONGO -- GRASSY AREA - EVENING

document_metadata.title: 29、INT. CAPSULE
document_metadata.summary: The spacecraft lands, and Zarkov exclaims they've made it, though unsure of the location. Dale reacts with fear as strange men approach, expressing a desire to stay inside.

chunks.content: (DALE, FLASH, ZARKOV) Gentle bump as the thing touches down. . ZARKOV By God, we did it! We made it! FLASH Made it where, Doctor? ZARKOV I don't know. Suddenly DALE gasps, reacting to something she SEES through the transparent-from-within wall. They all look around and SEE those STRANGE MEN approaching. DALE Don't. Suddenly I like it in here just fine --

document_metadata.title: 30、EXT. GRASSY AREA - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Flash, Dale, and Zarkov are captured by Red Men, handcuffed, and declared prisoners to be taken to Ming the Merciless, ruler of the universe.

chunks.content: The door of the CAPSULE is opened from the inside. ZARKOV and DALE and FLASH get out. THE MEN stop. Long beat as the two parties gaze at each other, the first human eye ever to see an extraterrestrial being. FLASH walks up to the leader. FLASH Hello -- my name's Flash Gordon -- can you understand me? (SILENCE) We're from EARTH -- we come as friends. ZARKOV (URGENT) Extend your hand! That's the gesture of friendship known everywhere! With a warm grin, FLASH extends his right hand. FLASH Hi!

metadata.title: 30、EXT. GRASSY AREA - DAY
metadata.summary: Flash, Dale, and Zarkov are captured by Red Men, handcuffed, and declared prisoners to be taken to Ming the Merciless, ruler of the universe.

chunks.content: CLACK! With lightning speed a manacle is slammed on FLASH'S wrist and he is thrown to the ground as other RED MEN advance to handcuff DALE and ZARKOV. LEADER You are prisoners. I will take you now to Ming the Merciless, Ruler of the universe! ARMORED MEN (CHORUS) Hail, Ming!Groggily, FLASH lifts his head towards ZARKOV. FLASH Thanks, Doctor -- next time I'll call my own play.

metadata.title: 30、EXT. GRASSY AREA - DAY
metadata.summary: Flash, Dale, and Zarkov are captured by Red Men, handcuffed, and declared prisoners to be taken to Ming the Merciless, ruler of the universe.

document_metadata.title: 31、EXT. GRASSY AREA - POV THROUGH OPENING
document_metadata.summary: Dale and Flash witness a brutal scene of a tormented beast and a dead man; Dale closes her eyes, imagining they were at Disneyland instead.

chunks.content: (DALE, FLASH) Another strange glimpse through an opening. Some fierce tethered BEAST is being goaded and tormented by MONGO MEN, as in an Elizabethan bear-baiting. On the floor lies the tor n body of one MAN who apparently got too close. DALE has one brief horrified GLIMPSE of this, then turns her head away and shuts her eyes as she's marched along. DALE Just do what I'm doing. Flash -- FLASH What are you doing? DALE Shutting my eyes -- dreaming I booked us to Disneyland.

document_metadata.title: 32、INT. MAIN PALACE HALL
document_metadata.summary: Ming the Merciless sits in a throne within a statue, receiving prisoners as armored men hail him, their shouts echoing through the palace.

chunks.content: (ARMORED MEN) A gigantic STATUE comes into view amidst topless columns at the end. Light plays over it in ever-shifting patterns. As we come nearer, we SEE that this STATUE is cut out in the middle to form a throne. MING THE MERCILESS sits in the throne niche, silent, gazing down on the PRISONERS as they are marched to a halt before him. ARMORED MEN Hail, Ming! Hail, Great One Without Mercy! A hundred reduplicated ECHOES of that shout ring through unseen reaches of the palace. MING bends his head slightly in acknowledgement, points idly at the ARMORED MEN at the left of the group.

document_metadata.doc_title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES
document_metadata.title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES
document_metadata.summary: Flash hesitates to fight the Amazons, but after Dale's outburst calling them murderous dykes, he overcomes his reluctance and attacks the nearest pair.
document_metadata.source_title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES

chunks.content: As FLASH, DALE and ZARKOV are marched along by many ARMORED MEN, perspectives are bewildering, curvilinear, surfaces bending away into caverns of gloom without measurable dimension. We pass an archway opening into what seems to be an AMUSEMENT ARCADE. Glimpse of MONGO PEOPLE playing amazing electronic games, while MONGO GO-GO GIRLS cavort on a platform to unearthly music. ZARKOV Fantastic -- into a Black Hole and out the other side -- to this. Who said Hans Zarkov was mad? DALE You're mad. Look down over a balcony from a MOVING POV. A fencing glass is in session. SIX PAIRS OF MEN go at each other with magic swords which give off pyrotechnical displays each time the blades clash. Thrust, parry, SLASH! The head of one duellist EXPLODES in a bloodless fountain of fire. FLASH You got us into this -- HOW DO WE GET OUT? ZARKOV Get out? Why? We're being taken to Ming -- getting at him is our only hope of saving EARTH. It's perfect! FLASH Dr. Zarkov, I'm about to show you what it feels like to be clipped by a New York Giant -- DALE Flash, it's no use - he's too crazy! MING Step forward, Soldier. The designated one marches two paces forward, halts. MING (CONT'D) Are you loyal to Ming? Would you die for him? ARMORED MAN Gladly! MING Fall on your sword. Instantly the ARMORED MAN pulls his sword, rips open his breastplate, sets the sword hilt-down on the floor and PLUNGES FORWARD on to the fatal point. With a little cry of horror, DALE shrinks back into FLASH'S arms. ZARKOV You inhuman fiend! MING Of course I'm \"inhuman\"! -- that's a compliment! (Dropping his voice) Pathetic Earthlings, forever wondering if you are alone in the universe -- beaming your plaintive messages into the void for anything that might hear you -- even hurling your bodies out into it -- and all without the faintest inkling of who or what is out here. If you had known anything -- anything at all about the true nature of the universe, you would have hidden from it, in terror!

metadata.doc_title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES
metadata.title: 33、INT. PALACE OF HALLS - SERIES OF DISSOLVES

chunks.content: There is a low throaty LAUGH from the shadows. FLASH and DALE turn their eyes quickly in its direction. FEATURE PRINCESS AURA Emerging half into the light beside a column, fondling the head of an obscure BEAST slouching between her legs. Voluptuous beyond her years, fiercely erotic, AURA looks FLASH boldly up and down as the BEAST HISSES with the pleasure of her touch. FLASH can't take his eyes off her. No normal man could. FLASH swallows with a dry throat as AURA'S gaze devours him. DALE gets the electricity going on, gives him a poke and WHISPERS LOUDLY. DALE Watch it, fella -- you came with me! AURA laughs again, sidles up toward MING. We dimly SEE a couple of MUTANT CREATURES dragging away the lifeless body of the one who so vividly proved his loyalty. MING You know who Ming is now -- who are you and why do you come to Mongo? FLASH I'm Flash Gordon of the New York Giants this is Dale Arden -- Dr. Zarkov hijacked us in an effort to save EARTH. MING looks questioningly at KLYTUS. KLYTUS Sirs, Earth is the meaningless planet you are in the process of obliterating. ZARKOV (pouncing on that) In the process? You mean Earth still exists?

chunks.content: MING For the moment -- not for much longer. FLASH But why? What in hell have we ever done to hurt you? MING You exist -- and yet you pay no homage to Ming! What greater crime can be committed? The palace rings with an answering chorus: VOICES of all the ARMORED MEN and numerous others presently UNSEEN, including many WOMEN. VOICES Hail, Ming! Hail, Great One Without Mercy! MING Come closer, Dale Arden -- let me see you. DALE doesn't move. MING takes a step down, narrows his eyes and gazes at her intensely. This guy's personal magnetism is enormous. As if irresistibly drawn, DALE steps forward. MING moves his hand in a gesture. A sourceless GOLDEN LIGHT bathes DALE, sensuous MUSICAL CHORDS are heard. DALE's lips open slightly, her color heightens, her rate of breathing increases. MING touches her flesh lightly. FLASH tense, ready to spring. KLYTUS This woman will amuse you. . ZARKOV (INTERESTED) Klytus can see the future, eh? MING He can foresee it -- but for a few moments only. It gives him a unique gift for survival, -- and treachery. ZARKOV Extraordinary. I'd like to study his beta factors -- I wager I could extend them with a course of telekinetic exercise. (peering at KLYTUS) Tell me -- when you use this fit does your temporal lobe prickle? Here? MING flashes a glance of interest at ZARKOV, then addresses the LEADER of the ARMORED MEN. MING Chain this one up. Preserve him for further examination. LEADER Hail, Ming! ZARKOV is roughly seized. FLASH starts after them angrily as they drag the scientist away. FLASH Oh no you don't! We came together and we're STAYING together!

chunks.content: Languidly, MING indicates FLASH GORDON with a pointed finger. MING That one is useless to us. Remove him and kill him. Shock reactions. FLASH wheels back at MING as DALE steps in front of her friend. DALE You dirty old bastard can kill me too! CLOSE ANGLE - AURA Wetting her lips, moving sinuously to WHISPER to MING: . AURA Don't kill him yet, Father. Give him to me! MING (EYEBROWS UP) What would your Prince Barin say? AURA I can handle Barin. MING Really, Aura -- your appetites are too monstrous -- even for our family. This could cause great trouble with Barin -- I must forbid it. AURA touches the rime of MING'S ear with her tongue as she WHISPERS AGAIN: AURA But you adore me, Father -- you can refuse me nothing. Yes? WIDER SHOT As MING steps quickly away from his super-provocative daughter and indicates DALE. MING Take the Earth-woman to our quarters! Bathe and annoint her for our pleasure! A HOODED GUARD comes from shadow, moves towards DALE. FLASH starts around to defend her, but before he can do it DALE has made her own move. WHAM! Quick as lightning, she flattened the HOODED GUARD with a perfectly executed city-girl's kick to the balls. DALE is astonished at her own prowess. DALE My God -- and I thought that book was another rip-off- FLASH Watch out! Behind you! Three more HOODED GUARDS are emerging from the shadows towards DALE. QUICK ANGLES . FLASH flies at them. An elbow in the mouth disposes of one. He seizes the man's mace-like club as he falls, uses it quickly to knock cold the other two. AURA'S eyes shine at FLASH'S prowess. Fascinated, she runs her moist tongue along the cutting edge of her teeth. Panting, braced, FLASH stands in front of DALE with raised mace.

chunks.content: Unearthly MARTIAL MUSIC comes in a glissando from the Cavernous space above. To its tempo MING'S PERSONAL GUARDS now start appearing. They are all a race of AMAZON WARRIORS, and the most amazing thing is that they all have the SAME FACE. From left to right, back and front, the AMAZONS advance on FLASH and DALE. They do not attack, merely stun and overwhelm with their massive, silent, unquestionable threat. FLASH swallows, looks this way and that, stands as if paralysed.

chunks.content: DALE (low and tremulous) What's the play, Flash? FLASH I can't -- I just can't -- DALE Can't what? FLASH Clobber a woman, Dale -- DALE (OUTBURST) You damn fool, those aren't women they're murderous AMAZON DYKES! The AMAZONS are all around DALE now. DALE (CONT'D) Help!!FLASH is paralyzed by indecision one beat more, then suddenly makes up his mind. He flies into action, SLAMS the nearest pair of AMAZONS. .

document_metadata.title: 34、INT. PALACE - FIGHT SEQUENCE
document_metadata.summary: FLASH and DALE fight fiercely against the AMAZONS, but overwhelmed by numbers, FLASH is pinned. Seeing DALE taken away, he breaks free and chases after her.

chunks.content: (DALE) Fast and furious. Great havoc is wreaked by DALE and her karate, by FLASH and his flailing fists, but the AMAZONS' numerical superiority is of course decisive. Soon FLASH is on the floor, pinioned by a dozen AMAZONS. He looks up, with despairing eyes SEES poor DALE being dragged up a flight of stairs that disappear mysteriously into upper gloom. DALE Flash!! The pitiful shout sends FLASH'S adrenaline rushing. With a superhuman effort, he fights free from the pile-up and dashes after DALE.

document_metadata.title: 35、INT. PALACE - ON THE STAIRCASE
document_metadata.summary: FLASH falls through a trapdoor while reaching for DALE; AURA jumps after him before it closes, as DALE fights off attackers.

chunks.content: FLASH struggles to get through to DALE. DALE claws fiercely at the bare AMAZON arms and shoulders that engulf her, reaches desperately back down for FLASH. CLOSE SHOT - THEIR HANDS Just touching their fingertips. CLOSE SHOT - A STEP OF THE STAIRS Opens like a yawning trap door UNDER FLASH'S FEET. FLASH drops away with a YELL, in the very instant that AURA comes running INTO THE SHOT and boldly JUMPS after him. AURA is swallowed up too, a split-second before the trap door step CLOSES again after them.

document_metadata.title: 36、INT. PALACE - CU-MING
document_metadata.summary: Ming considers marrying Dale Arden despite Klytus's warning of betrayal, but Klytus vanishes before revealing her fate, leaving Ming contemplative and smiling.

chunks.content: (KLYTUS, MING) Watching that, as KLYTUS hisses into his ear. KLYTUS She betrays you! She'll take him to Aboria! MING So Prince Barin will kill Flash Gordon for me -- I don't care. KLYTUS Don't be too sure! . MING glances at him, then back up the stairs at where DALE has vanished. His face softens, his tone turns museful! MING I haven't taken a wife in centuries. I could bring myself to marry this Dale Arden -- (A BEAT) What do you see in her future, Klytus? NO reply. MING turns his head and finds that KLYTUS is gone. Vanished. Not particularly surprised or concerned, MING gazes again toward the top of the stairs and answers his own question with a licentious smile.

chunks.content: (AURA, FLASH) It is seemingly endless, faintly lt by phosphoresence from below. We dimly make out the figures of FLASH and AURA falling away from us, far below, falling, falling. We HEAR Hollow echoing VOICES reverbrating up to us. AURA Take a deep breath! Grab my ankle after we hit the water -- I'll lead you! FLASH Hit what water? In answer, we instantly HEAR a titanic SPLASH.

document_metadata.title: 38、INT. UNDERWATER (TANK)
document_metadata.summary: FLASH and AURA descend into a bubble-filled cavern where FLASH confronts a giant LUMINOUS FISH, then follows AURA through stalagmites and a low opening out of sight.

chunks.content: FLASH plummets down, AURA right after him. Recovering balance in a universe of bubbles, FLASH finds himself confronting an enormous savage LUMINOUS FISH. Wheeling himself away in fear and revulsion, FLASH encounters AURA. He seizes her ankle as directed. Holding his beat, FLASH swims after her through a maze of stalagmites growing up from the cavern floor. AURA dives down, leads him OUT OF SIGHT through a low opening.

document_metadata.title: 39、INT. UNDERGROUND GROTTO
document_metadata.summary: AURA questions FLASH's trust in her as Ming's daughter; he admits his honesty, and she finds his genuine nature intriguing, highlighting his humble heroism.

chunks.content: FLASH and AURA emerge from a pool of water. FLASH staggers across and collapses on a fringe of beach. For sure, AURA'S wet clinging robe doesn't make her look any less sexy. He stares at her. AURA tells him to catch his breath, then she'll take him up and find a disguise. FLASH responds that she's saving his life and asks how he can thank her. AURA says she'll fly him to the forest of Arboria — they'll find a way forward. Despite his vulnerability, FLASH insists on setting things straight: he must find Dale and Zarkov, rescue them, and try to save Earth as well.

metadata.title: 39、INT. UNDERGROUND GROTTO
metadata.summary: AURA questions FLASH's trust in her as Ming's daughter; he admits his honesty, and she finds his genuine nature intriguing, highlighting his humble heroism.

chunks.content: AURA challenges his trust, reminding him that she is Ming's daughter and questioning how foolish he is to reveal his plans to her. FLASH admits he's no good at lying, showing his blunt honesty. AURA finds him amusing, wondering if all Earthlings are like him. FLASH, with characteristic humility, replies that he's probably about average — a simple statement that underscores his unassuming heroism and genuine nature.

document_metadata.title: 40、INT. UNDERGROUND CORRIDOR
document_metadata.summary: AURA reveals the plasma core powers Ming's energy beam targeting Earth; enslaved Lizard Men, punished for rebelling, toil eternally in a magma cavern under brutal conditions.

chunks.content: (AURA, FLASH) There are windows on one side, emitting a fierce GLARE. FLASH follows AURA rapidly along. Suddenly he stops short, looking in through the tinted glass. WHAT HE SEES - PLASMA CAVERN An infernal place, chief feature of which is a LAKE OF SEETHING MAGMA that slowly rotates within a wide encircling platform. The platform is piled with GLOWING RADIOACTIVE GRAVEL, being shoveled into the magma by LIZARDMAN SLAVES who toil in rhythmic unison. ANGLES - LIZARDMAN SLAVES. Showing ankle electrodes shackled to each SLAVE, so that those who collapse can be shocked back to their feet by GUARDS stationed on a surrounding catwalk above. Any SLAVE unable to rise is summarily pitched into the magma by HOODED MEN, waiting like executioners to perform this chore.

metadata.title: 40、INT. UNDERGROUND CORRIDOR
metadata.summary: AURA reveals the plasma core powers Ming's energy beam targeting Earth; enslaved Lizard Men, punished for rebelling, toil eternally in a magma cavern under brutal conditions.

chunks.content: FLASH (O.S.) What's that? AURA (O.S.) The plasma core. It's the source of the energy-beam my father is aiming at Earth. You can't stop it. Ming is merciless and all-powerful! AURA (O.S.) (CONT'D) The slaves are Lizard Men. Once they had their own water Kingdom, the fairest of Mongo. Then they dared to rebel. They will suffer for it here forever.FLASH looks at AURA again, then back in the window. He reacts.

document_metadata.doc_title: 41、INT. GROTTO - HIS POV IN CAVERN - ON A CATWALK

chunks.content: (EVERYONE, MING, ZARKOV) High above this place where MING stands with KLYTUS, lit by the infernal glare as he goes on: . MING I am forcing this plasma through the successive nuclear phases of a star - building it toward the apocalyptic moment that will end Earth's pathetic history in one flash of fire. ZARKOV Devil! Why don't you turn this science to peaceful use? The name Ming would be blessed instead of cursed. MING Bring him up to the dome, Soldiers -- we wish to show him wonders. document_metadata.title: 44、INT. UPPER PALACE AREA - CORRIDOR
document_metadata.summary: Aura leads Flash to a hangar with rocket ships, revealing his disguise as a Royal Pilot, and insists he will learn to fly one with her guidance despite his doubts.

chunks.content: AURA leads FLASH out through a doorway. He is now fitted out with a fairly resplendent MONGO costume: boots, cape, headdress and all. They hurry along through shadows. Suddenly FLASH seizes her by the shoulders, stops her. FLASH Listen, where's he got Dale? As she looks at him, she SEES a detachment of SOLDIERS marching this direction. Quickly she pulls FLASH into a niche, presses her body against his in the narrow space. WHISPERS: AURA Forget Dale Arden! FLASH I can't! I mean I hardly know her, BUT -- AURA Forget her, Flash Gordon: I saw a look in my father's eye -- I think he intends to marry her. FLASH What?? Marry her? What are you talking about?? The SOLDIERS have gone past, but AURA is still pressing against him. AURA Oh you ask so many questions. (SEDUCTIVE) I'm taking you to people who'll help you. Trust me! FLASH Can I honestly? AURA Trust me!

chunks.content: AURA hauls FLASH from the niche, they hurry on a bit further. AURA stops in front of big doors, with glass windows in them. AURA (CONT'D) Here we are. FLASH Here we are where? AURA I've dressed you as a Royal Pilot, First Class. We'll slip into my personal car and you'll fly it. FLASH takes one look into the glass, then swivels back to AURA FLASH Those are ROCKET SHIPS in there! I can't fly a damn rocket ship!AURA (soft, teasing) Learn from me -- I'll teach you so much!

document_metadata.title: 45、INT. MING'S DOME
document_metadata.summary: Zarkov realizes Ming plans to repopulate Earth with Dale Arden as his mate; he attempts to draw a sword from a crystal block, but fails, as it can only be wielded by Ming or his heir.

chunks.content: Open at the top to space. But instead of our familiar pinpoint stars, here whole nebulae wheel in majesty against infinity, their innards popping with explosions as whole galaxies are born and die. ZARKOV stands before MING in chains, mesmerized by fantastic devices on every side. Most prominent is a huge transparent cube, supported in the air above a control console. MING moves to that, plays in it like an organist. we HEAR a soft intense hum, GLIMPSE great dish-like radio antennae turning on the top side of the dome. An astonishing thing happens. Inside the cube a recognisable greenish globe appears like a three-dimensional holograph, slowly turning as the continents and oceans come into view below a veil of clouds. ZARKOV Earth! MING Yes, Zarkov -- as it was. Now as it will be, when my plasma reaches full force..... A sudden TIDE OF FIRE sweeps the globe, Even the clouds BURN. ZARKOV gasps as MING'S fingers dance of the control keys again. MING (CONT'D) And as it will be in yet another time, long after you have died. Earth reborn! A pleasant image, no? The fires recede. The hanging globe sparkles again with beauty just as it was except that the outlines of our continents have been subtly changed.

metadata.title: 45、INT. MING'S DOME
metadata.summary: Zarkov realizes Ming plans to repopulate Earth with Dale Arden as his mate; he attempts to draw a sword from a crystal block, but fails, as it can only be wielded by Ming or his heir.

chunks.content: ZARKOV But that's impossible! Even your perverted genius can't create new life! MING Of course I can create life. There's nothing easier. It only requires myself and one woman. ZARKOV (SUDDEN UNDERSTANDING) Dale Arden..... MING Who else? As in that childish myth of yours -- Adam and Eve, wasn't it? I will breed with her and repopulate the Earth in my own image. I've already done it on over a thousand planets. MING touches a key. The image of Earth DISAPPEARS from the cube. ZARKOV glares hatred at MING for a beat, then his eye catches something else. WHAT HE SEES . A big block of crystal on the floor with two swords embedded in it, just their hilts sticking out. ANGLE to include ZARKOV. Chained as he is, he suddenly bounds over and seizes a sword hilt, tries to pull it out. It doesn't budge. MING (CONT'D) The magic blades are not for your kind, Zarkov. One is my own the other will only be withdrawn by my rightful heir. Pull on them with all your MIGHT: ZARKOV tugs desperately, but it doesn't give an inch. He falls panting over the block. ZARKOV Monster! MING laughs, makes a sign to a SOLDIER. MING Return him to the dungeon.

document_metadata.title: 46、INT. MING'S SERAGLIO
document_metadata.summary: Dale, after hesitating and calling for Flash, impulsively drinks the green potion offered by Hedonia, finding its effects surprisingly pleasant despite her initial distrust.

chunks.content: DALE stands amongst the EXOTIC FEMALES of this lavish place, being gently but firmly divested of her clothes and put into a diaphanous gown. They intend her no harm. Though each has some slight unearthly peculiarity, all are very beautiful. Tickled, DALE can't suppress a giggle. The females are amazed and delighted by this phenomenon. They take turns poking at her ribs as tall HEDONIA glides up, bearing a flagon of green liquid. HEDONIA offers it to her, saying only, 'Drink this.' DALE recoils, her giggling cut short, suspicious of the unknown substance. She demands to know what it is, fearing a drug. HEDONIA explains it has no name but was brought from Cythera, the planet of Pleasure, at great cost and sacrifice, promising it will make her time with Ming more bearable.

metadata.title: 46、INT. MING'S SERAGLIO
metadata.summary: Dale, after hesitating and calling for Flash, impulsively drinks the green potion offered by Hedonia, finding its effects surprisingly pleasant despite her initial distrust.

chunks.content: With a swift karate chop, DALE knocks the flagon from HEDONIA's hand. HEDONIA rubs her wrist but shows no anger, instead appealing to DALE with calm empathy. She acknowledges their racial differences but emphasizes their shared womanhood, urging DALE to trust her and drink the potion to ease what lies ahead. Retrieving the flagon from a silken pillow, she extends it once more. In that moment, DALE cries out desperately, 'Flash! Where are you??'—a plea met with silence. Overcome by despair, tears well in her eyes as she suddenly grabs the flagon and drinks the liquid impulsively.Her expression shifts, surprise replacing anguish. 'Say, this stuff isn't bad at all,' DALE murmurs, the effects beginning to take hold.

document_metadata.title: 50、INT. COCKPIT - ANOTHER SHOT
document_metadata.summary: Aura attempts to contact Prince Barin for help using a telepathic device, teasing Flash with the possibility of contacting Dale. Flash seizes control, overpowering Aura.

chunks.content: Another moon RISING ahead. Its reddish desert surface is swept by a raging sandstorm. FLASH wonders if anyone lives on it, and AURA confirms that the Sand Men do, explaining that every Moon is a separate kingdom, each hostile to the others. Despite their differences, they share only two things: subjugation under Ming's rule and a deep hatred for him. When FLASH suggests they unite against Ming, AURA laughs at the idea, reminding him of the fate of the Lizard Men. FLASH grows thoughtful, noting that their defeat wasn't a coordinated effort, which sparks a new line of thinking.

metadata.title: 50、INT. COCKPIT - ANOTHER SHOT
metadata.summary: Aura attempts to contact Prince Barin for help using a telepathic device, teasing Flash with the possibility of contacting Dale. Flash seizes control, overpowering Aura.

chunks.content: AURA studies him briefly, then reaches for a strange device above her seat—a transparent hood with internal fittings resembling a telekinetic thought transfer machine. She begins adjusting its dials, explaining she’ll use it to contact Prince Barin of Arboria, the man who will help FLASH. When he asks why Barin would assist, she smirks and says simply, 'Because he loves me.' Intrigued, FLASH asks if the device could let him contact Dale, and AURA teases that she could teach him—but won’t. Her refusal lingers in the air as FLASH suddenly moves, sharply manipulating the control panel.The craft lurches into a violent dive. AURA cries out in alarm, dropping the hood and lunging toward the controls—but FLASH is faster, seizing her wrists before she can react.

document_metadata.title: 66、EXT. ARBORIA FOREST - FLASH AND AURA

document_metadata.title: 75、INT. LODGE
document_metadata.summary: Aura manipulates Barin into testing Flash's courage by facing a deadly serpent; Flash must prove himself as Barin demands a volunteer to confront the beast.

chunks.content: FLASH is flattened against the wall, watching through the louvers of a door. Sounds of feet on the ramp, the snarling and roaring of a captive Tiger Man fill the air. BARIN hurries into view on the balcony and embraces AURA. As they part, BARIN asks, 'You'll stay the night?' AURA replies, 'I've dreamed of it!' Her eyes gleam as BARIN steps back, his men arriving with the netted Tiger Man. He demands a sword and turns to AURA: 'This is the fiercest Tiger Man we have ever hunted. I'm going to kill him now — and dedicate his blood to you, my beloved.' AURA, delighted, responds, 'But that's treason! Blood can be dedicated to Ming alone!' BARIN, confident, says, 'I know you, Aura — the more a man risks, the greater your passion. If I knew a greater risk, I'd take it.' AURA smiles, then calls softly into the interior: 'Flash Gordon — come out!' FLASH steps forward, stopping ten feet from BARIN. The arrival stuns BARIN and his men. FLASH introduces himself: 'I'm from Earth, Prince Barin. My friends and I were Ming's prisoners. She kindly brought me here to enlist your help.' BARIN scoffs, 'What in hell? My help?' AURA quickly interjects, 'Hide him from my father — don't let him wander — keep him for me!'

metadata.title: 75、INT. LODGE
metadata.summary: Aura manipulates Barin into testing Flash's courage by facing a deadly serpent; Flash must prove himself as Barin demands a volunteer to confront the beast.

chunks.content: FLASH stares, stunned: 'Keep me for...???? Oh, my god. I trusted you.' AURA darts into frame, presses her lips to his ear, and whispers, 'You still must — I'm playing a game!' She reappears at BARIN's side, whispering again: 'He's a mere toy to me, my love — when I'm tired of it, we'll kill him!' Stepping back, she speaks aloud: 'It's the risk I ask, Barin — hide him for me in Arboria.' BARIN retorts, 'I'll hide him, all right — under six feet of Arborian dirt!' The sword he ordered arrives; he seizes it. FLASH pleads, 'I'm not your enemy, Prince Barin. We share a hatred of Ming.' AURA challenges, 'Are you so afraid of my Earthling, Barin? Won't you even give him a chance?' Provoked, BARIN hesitates, then shouts, 'Snake keeper! Rouse your beast!' A halfwit Tree Man stirs from the parapet, shuffles to a large wicker basket, and removes the lid. A hideous eel-like serpent rears up, hissing and snapping. The keeper thrusts his arm in; the snake coils around it. With a drooling grin, he withdraws it.The KEEPER carries the hissing snake toward a massive tree stump. He holds his arm over the hollowed trunk and whistles a curious note. The snake leaps off and vanishes inside. Six holes are now visible in the gnarled wood. BARIN demands, 'Who dares the beast?' A battle-scarred OLD TREE MAN steps forward silently, approaches the stump, and plunges his hand into one of the holes. Inside the stump, a close-up reveals the snake striking the wrist with a hiss.

document_metadata.summary: Ming contemptuously targets Vultan, plans to enslave his Hawkmen, and manipulates events by letting Vultan subdue Dale first, dismissing Flash as insignificant while showing arrogance and strategic control.

chunks.content: In his wondrous DOME ROOM, MING watches a scene unfold on the VIEWING SCREEN, PULLING BACK to reveal KLYTUS standing beside him as usual. The screen shows a continuation of the previous moment: DALE struggling as HAWKMEN carry her into the open sky. The atmosphere is tense, imperial, and charged with control. KLYTUS observes cautiously, then remarks that Mongo is restless, noting that MING’s vessels are straying from their appointed kingdoms, suggesting a growing disorder within the empire’s domains.

metadata.title: 87、INT. MING'S DOME ROOM
metadata.summary: Ming contemptuously targets Vultan, plans to enslave his Hawkmen, and manipulates events by letting Vultan subdue Dale first, dismissing Flash as insignificant while showing arrogance and strategic control.

chunks.content: MING responds with contempt, singling out Vultan as the source of defiance, vowing to clip his wings and enslave his Hawkmen in the plasma caverns. KLYTUS then asks whether he should dispatch the Imperial Fleet to retrieve Dale Arden and Flash Gordon, but MING dismisses the idea, preferring to let Vultan subdue Dale first, confident that she will find him more appealing afterward. He devalues Flash Gordon, calling him nobody, revealing both arrogance and a calculated manipulation of personal and political dynamics.

document_metadata.title: 88、EXT. SKY - WIDE SHOT
document_metadata.summary: Hawkmen carry Flash, Barin, and Tiger Man past clouds to a radiant sky palace, then dive rapidly into its depths, descending into a realm of mystery and power.

chunks.content: Serried squadrons of HAWKMEN escort the ones bearing FLASH, BARIN and TIGER MAN through space. CLOSER - TIGER MAN struggling against the TWO HAWKMEN who have him, snarling and roaring. He butts one in the belly with his horn. HAWKMAN taunts, 'Want us to let you go, et?' TIGER MAN growls, 'Yes!!' With a sudden release, he plummets, screaming, 'Nooo!!!' The moment captures his panic as he falls away from the formation, only to be caught again in the relentless grip of his captors.

metadata.title: 88、EXT. SKY - WIDE SHOT
metadata.summary: Hawkmen carry Flash, Barin, and Tiger Man past clouds to a radiant sky palace, then dive rapidly into its depths, descending into a realm of mystery and power.

chunks.content: SKY - WIDE PANORAMA reveals light streaming through tremendous El Greco clouds. The HAWKMEN appear as tiny figures rising against the vast sky. Higher they climb, ascending beyond the cloud layer, where a blinding DAZZLE comes INTO FRAME. It resolves into a fantastic SKY PALACE hanging in mid-air, reflecting sunlight from myriad turrets and terraces. The structure glows with otherworldly grandeur, suspended in the heavens like a dream made real.The HAWKMEN climb above the palace, then begin a screaming dive, carrying FLASH, BARIN, and TIGER MAN into the unknown depths of this aerial fortress. Wind whips around them as they descend rapidly, the terraces and spires blurring into streaks of light and shadow. The descent feels both ceremonial and ominous, signaling entry into a new realm of power and mystery.

document_metadata.title: 91、EXT. SKY PALACE - ANOTHER LEVEL
document_metadata.summary: Flash and Zarkov reunite as Dale is attacked by jealous Hawkgirls and nearly thrown from a terrace; Flash saves her, they embrace, and are captured mid-kiss by Hawkmen.

chunks.content: HAWKMEN carrying FLASH, TIGER MAN and BARIN swoop OUT from another hole like the one they dove into. The whole place is like a great hanging birdhouse, HAWKWOMEN and HAWCHILDREN moving in and out and perching on the various exterior terraces. FLASH and TIGER MAN are dropped onto a terrace, so hard it stuns them. BARIN is lowered more carefully onto another terrace, this one grander, with a throne in the center. FEATURE VULTAN flying down from above, hovering above BARIN with menacing glee. VULTAN: Ho! -- Barin! I knew my Hawkmen would catch you one of these days. SARIN: Be careful how you address me, Vultan. I am Prince Barin, ruler of Arboria. VULTAN: Not in my Kingdom -- here you're just a stray animal to be killed for our sport! BARIN: Will you do that, Vultan? VULTAN: What would you do if you'd caught me in Arboria? BARIN: Yes -- I would hunt you down and kill you without mercy.

metadata.title: 91、EXT. SKY PALACE - ANOTHER LEVEL
metadata.summary: Flash and Zarkov reunite as Dale is attacked by jealous Hawkgirls and nearly thrown from a terrace; Flash saves her, they embrace, and are captured mid-kiss by Hawkmen.

chunks.content: FLASH on the OTHER TERRACE lifts his head groggily, reacts to something. ANGLE TO INCLUDE ZARKOV, stumbling out from an opening in his usual clothes. ZARKOV: Hello - we do meet in the strangest places. FLASH: Where's Dale? ZAAKOV: The boss-bird has her up in his... Sudden ear-piercing SCREAM from above. DALE'S scream. FLASH bounds to his feet. IN THE EYRIE, DALE is surrounded by jealous HAWKGIRLS who are pushing her toward the terrace edge. Screaming again, DALE goes OVER. SPACE BETWEEN TWO TERRACES / ONE TERRACE, FLASH wheels toward the sound, dives to the parapet and catches DALE as she plunges past. DALE: Flash! Oh darling! FLASH: Dale baby! He hauls her in and they embrace in a steamy kiss.FLUTTER of wings. HAWKMEN swoop at the terrace and LIFT UP the clinging couple. It barely interrupts their conversation: DALE: Flash -- when I was in that tub -- FLASH: Yes -- it was me -- DALE: Did you mean it? FLASH: Every thought, baby! --

document_metadata.title: 92、EXT. VULTAN'S TERRACE
document_metadata.summary: Barin demands a duel with Flash, Vultan seeks to execute Barin, and Dale criticizes their lack of teamwork; Vultan proposes a bravery test, prompting Hawkmen to cheer for a joust, and orders them taken below.

chunks.content: As FLASH and DALE are lowered onto the terrace, VULTAN confronts them, demanding to know what they have to say to him, Prince of the Air. FLASH responds that they are all prisoners of Ming and proposes they unite to overthrow him. From another terrace, TIGER MAN shouts in support, declaring Flash Gordon the leader they’ve been waiting for, despite his own humble status as an 'ignorant Tiger Man.' His words echo across the space, stirring something in the air. VULTAN turns to FLASH with mocking eyes, questioning his leadership, while FLASH tries to explain his past as an athlete back home, referencing a game against the Dallas Cowboys—a story lost on the alien ears around him.

metadata.title: 92、EXT. VULTAN'S TERRACE
metadata.summary: Barin demands a duel with Flash, Vultan seeks to execute Barin, and Dale criticizes their lack of teamwork; Vultan proposes a bravery test, prompting Hawkmen to cheer for a joust, and orders them taken below.

chunks.content: BARIN, cold and detached, interrupts, revealing he was hunting FLASH when VULTAN captured him, and insists on finishing their duel before any alliance is considered. VULTAN, amused, pleads to be allowed to execute BARIN first. DALE, exasperated, cries out whether everyone on Mongo is crazy, questioning why they can’t grasp the concept of teamwork. FLASH appeals directly to BARIN, reminding him that he had the chance to kill him with the snake but chose not to, proving his honor. BARIN counters that he had FLASH in his sights and could have killed him instantly. VULTAN silences them, calling to his Hawkmen and proposing a test of their bravery.He declares, 'These vagrants talk a brave fight, my Hawkmen! Shall we test their words?' The Hawkpeople erupt in cheers—'Test them! Let's have sport! The joust! To the joust!'—their voices rising in eager anticipation. VULTAN commands, 'Take them below -- put them together.'

metadata.title: 92、EXT. VULTAN'S TERRACE

chunks.content: (DALE, FLASH, ZARKOV) VULTAN leads the way down. FLASH, BARIN, DALE, ZAAKOV and TIGER MAN are escorted by many fierce HAWKMEN. DALE Flash - don't do this. FLASH (low, bitter) I've got to. DALE Why? ZARKOV He has no choice, Dale it's the Mongo way. DALE I'm so homesick -- what I wouldn't give for a nice quiet night with some muggers in Central Park -- FLASH squeezes DALE'S hand. Ahead appears an archway opening to the sky. A GREAT GONG is heard. ANOTHER TERRACE ANGLE - HAWKMAN appears with a mallet, he beats again on a huge bronze GONG.

document_metadata.title: 95、EXT. A LOWER PLATFORM
document_metadata.summary: FLASH and BARIN advance with HAWKMEN across a bridge; VULTAN arms the disc, revealing razor-sharp knives that pose a lethal threat to anyone crossing.

chunks.content: FLASH and the OTHERS appear, halting as they gaze at the disc. VULTAN commands, 'Prepare them!' On the disc, a HAWKMAN is greasing the shiny surface with a mop, slipping slightly as he works. On another terrace, ASH and BARIN are being readied for combat—removing their shirts, being fitted with heavy leather gauntlets, and each receiving a long, vicious WHIP. The scene shifts to the lower platform, where a bridge-like plank extends out over the edge of the greased disc.

metadata.title: 95、EXT. A LOWER PLATFORM
metadata.summary: FLASH and BARIN advance with HAWKMEN across a bridge; VULTAN arms the disc, revealing razor-sharp knives that pose a lethal threat to anyone crossing.

chunks.content: FLASH and BARIN emerge, ready for battle, accompanied by HAWKMEN behind them as they begin to cross the bridge. VULTAN calls out, 'Arm the disc!' Close-up on FLASH—he stops abruptly, eyes widening in shock as he sees the disc now bristling with razor-sharp knives popping up from its surface, spaced about two feet apart. The deadly implication is clear: any misstep or fall will result in fatal impalement.

metadata.title: 95、EXT. A LOWER PLATFORM
metadata.summary: FLASH and BARIN advance with HAWKMEN across a bridge; VULTAN arms the disc, revealing razor-sharp knives that pose a lethal threat to anyone crossing.

document_metadata.title: 96、INT. LOWER PLATFORM
document_metadata.summary: Flash defeats Barin in combat but saves him from falling; Vultan demands Barin's death, but Flash shows mercy, prompting Zarkov to praise compassion as Ming's voice interrupts.

chunks.content: FEATURE FLASH and BARIN with whips in hand, they step from the bridge onto the disc. FLASH almost slips and falls immediately. QUICK CU - DALE DALE Flash!! CU - FLASH, getting his balance again. BARIN moves across amidst the knives, takes a stance facing FLASH, raises and coils back his whip. BARIN Ready for me, Earthling? FLASH (POISED LIKEWISE) I ask you to swear, Barin -- if you defeat me, you'll join Vultan against Ming! If for no other reasons, because you'll never have Aura as long as her father lives! BARIN What do you now of Aura? FLASH Quite a lot! ZWIPPP! BARIN'S whip lashes out savagely at FLASH. ANGLES - FLASH AND BARIN - SPECTATOR REACTIONS Suddenly the fight begins. FLASH and BARIN stalk around, slipping on the grease, whamming at each other with their whips. The disc suddenly begins to TILT and SWAY, making this affair even more desperate. BARIN begins to get an edge. Slashing, cutting, he drives FLASH back.

metadata.title: 96、INT. LOWER PLATFORM
metadata.summary: Flash defeats Barin in combat but saves him from falling; Vultan demands Barin's death, but Flash shows mercy, prompting Zarkov to praise compassion as Ming's voice interrupts.

chunks.content: CU DALE DALE Flash, I love you! Win for me, Flash!? FEATURE FLASH Adrenaline courses through his veins as he hears that over the uproar. He flies at BARIN, dodges the lash, grapples with him hand-to-hand. They wrestle their way to the very rim of the swaying tilting surface. It looks bad again for FLASH, when with a superhuman effort he flips BARIN over his back... over the edge! In the same instant, FLASH dives onto his side amidst the deadly knives and grabs at BARIN'S wrist. FLASH catches him. BARIN hangs suspended over the abyss of space held only by FLASH'S grip. VULTAN You've won, Earthling! Drop him to doom! FLASH (gasping at BARIN) Try to catch my wrist! -- the other one. VULTAN What is this?? ZARKOV Call it what you want, Vultan -- compassion -- mercy: let us teach you the meaning of these words. FLASH (TO BARIN) Swing your body -- see if you can get a leg up here!Suddenly an ECHOING VOICE BOOMS from the sky: MING'S VOICE Vultan! Hear Ming, Ruler of the Universe!

document_metadata.title: 97、INT. MING'S DOME
document_metadata.summary: Vultan defies Ming, chooses to save Earthlings, and commands his Hawkmen to fly, bewildered by Zarkov's gesture of solidarity despite his chains.

chunks.content: Ming watches the Sky Palace scene on a viewing screen, a weeping Aura beside him, as he erupts in fury: 'I see you, Vultan -- and Barin too! You both have defied me by sparing these Earthlings!' Aura, distraught, whispers, 'Barin -- my only -- I swear I didn't mean to get you into this!' Meanwhile, Vultan hears Ming's voice echo ominously: 'Do you want to live, Vultan?' Vultan responds, 'What creature wants to die?' The voice presses: 'Then kill Flash Gordon now! Take Dale Arden and deliver her to me on your own wings -- it's your only chance! My fleet is already in the air, ready to destroy your entire kingdom if you disobey!' The threat reverberates and fades.

metadata.title: 97、INT. MING'S DOME
metadata.summary: Vultan defies Ming, chooses to save Earthlings, and commands his Hawkmen to fly, bewildered by Zarkov's gesture of solidarity despite his chains.

chunks.content: Suddenly, a Disc Tiger Man leaps onto the disc, sliding between the knives and helping Flash pull Barin to safety. Zarkov, still in chains, walks over to the conflicted Vultan and quietly asks, 'What'll you have -- death or dishonor?' Vultan looks down at Flash one more time, then makes his decision. He shouts to his people: 'We'll save these Earthlings! Curse Ming! Into the air, my Hawkmen -- fly!' Zarkov grins and extends a hand in solidarity, but Vultan stares at it, bewildered.I don't understand this. I think I've gone mad.

metadata.title: 97、INT. MING'S DOME
metadata.summary: Vultan defies Ming, chooses to save Earthlings, and commands his Hawkmen to fly, bewildered by Zarkov's gesture of solidarity despite his chains.

document_metadata.title: 98、INT. MING'S DOME

chunks.content: (AURA, MING) MING snaps off the viewing screen, looks at AURA AURA Spare him Daddy -- oh please spare BARIN -- AURA tries to throw herself into his arm, but he pushes her roughly away. KLYTUS materialises from a shadow, smiling. MING You've always wanted her, Klytus -- Aura is yours. .
