document_metadata.title: 101、EXT. SQUADRON OF HAWKMEN - IN FLIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Flash and Dale share a tender moment before Dale is abducted by a rocket ship's ray. Flash tries to rescue her, but Vultan's orders force his hawkman to dive away, leaving Dale's fate uncertain.

chunks.content: VULTAN and his CAPTAIN lead the group, with BARIN, FLASH, DALE, TIGER MAN, and ZARKOV each carried by a HAWKMAN through the sky. Distant explosions rumble like thunder, adding urgency to their flight. VULTAN urges forward without looking back, directing his men toward cloud cover for safety. He asks ZARKOV about the location of the capsule, and upon learning it's in the high grass east of Mingo, orders the CAPTAIN to retrieve it. The CAPTAIN and a few HAWKMEN break off from the formation to carry out the mission.

metadata.title: 101、EXT. SQUADRON OF HAWKMEN - IN FLIGHT
metadata.summary: Flash and Dale share a tender moment before Dale is abducted by a rocket ship's ray. Flash tries to rescue her, but Vultan's orders force his hawkman to dive away, leaving Dale's fate uncertain.

chunks.content: Meanwhile, FLASH and DALE, flying about a hundred feet apart, exchange loving glances. FLASH calls out to DALE, teasing her about what they'll do first upon landing, but DALE playfully rebukes him, blushing at the thought of such intimacy in front of the Hawkmen. FLASH insists, emphasizing the unpredictability of their situation. Their tender moment is abruptly shattered when a dark SHADOW falls over DALE. She looks up to see a massive ROCKET SHIP hovering above, its underside doors opening to unleash a flickering RAY.An effulgent GLOW envelops DALE and her HAWKMAN, pulling them inexorably upward. DALE cries out for help as she is being abducted. FLASH shouts that he's coming, demanding his HAWKMAN to follow and climb after her. However, VULTAN's command takes precedence, forcing the HAWKMAN bearing FLASH into a shrieking vertical dive along with the others, leaving DALE's rescue uncertain.

metadata.title: 101、EXT. SQUADRON OF HAWKMEN - IN FLIGHT
metadata.summary: Flash and Dale share a tender moment before Dale is abducted by a rocket ship's ray. Flash tries to rescue her, but Vultan's orders force his hawkman to dive away, leaving Dale's fate uncertain.

document_metadata.title: 102、INT. ROCKET SHIP
document_metadata.summary: Dale is captured and taken aboard a craft where Hedonia arrives with a wedding dress, revealing Ming's plan for her as soldiers subdue Dale's companion.

chunks.content: (DALE, HEDONIA) DALE and her HAWKMAN are sucked up into a chamber. Waiting SOLDIERS seize the struggling HAWKMAN, brutally smash his wings pitch him OUT the bottom as the doors close. DALE backs off, drops into a karate stance, With a WHINING ROAR the craft accelerates throwing DALE off balance against a wall. HEDONIA enters through a door, her arms full seems to be yards and yards of filmy white material. HEDONIA Smiles nicely. HEDONIA Time is short. Ming sent me to fit you with is. DALE Fit me with what? HEDONIA Your wedding dress.

chunks.content: TREE MEN and LION MEN and TIGER MAN toil together in peaceful concernt, constructing a crude wooden launch-gantry around ZARKOV'S SPACE CAPSULE, which has been conveyed here. . Several hovering HAWKMEN hold it in position with vine cables as the work is completed. Capsule door is open. Through it we see ZARKOV at work inside, feverishly re-wiring a control panel.

metadata.title: 103、EXT. ARBORIA - VINCINITY OF LODGE

document_metadata.title: 104、EXT. LODGE BALCONY
document_metadata.summary: Vultán refuses Barin's plan, deeming it suicidal, and departs despite appeals for vengeance; Flash accepts his choice and thanks him, as Zarkov interrupts with a call for a test.

chunks.content: Up on Lodge Balcony, FLASH, BARIN, and VULTAN lean over a table on which maps and drawings are laid out, a typical military staff meeting. With a bit of charcoal, BARIN sketches a semi-circular line over a map of MING'S city. BARIN explains that a force-field covers the entire city, from one end to the other, and suggests that with luck, Flash can lure the enemy into lowering their defenses. The plan hangs in the air, tense and uncertain.

metadata.title: 104、EXT. LODGE BALCONY
metadata.summary: Vultán refuses Barin's plan, deeming it suicidal, and departs despite appeals for vengeance; Flash accepts his choice and thanks him, as Zarkov interrupts with a call for a test.

chunks.content: VULTAN challenges the idea, calling it suicide and refusing to commit his men to what he sees as a doomed mission. He abruptly ascends into the air, hovering as he declares that the flight has brought him back to his senses—wishing them good luck but firmly taking his leave. BARIN reminds him that Ming destroyed his kingdom, appealing to his sense of justice and vengeance, but VULTAN responds coldly that they will build another, showing his resolve to move on rather than fight.BARIN calls after him desperately, but VULTAN hesitates only a moment before soaring away with determination. FLASH tells BARIN to let him go, saying he understands VULTAN's choice. As VULTAN departs, FLASH calls out thanks for the help they've already received. At that moment, ZARKOV'S VOICE breaks in: 'Flash! Ready for a test!'

metadata.title: 104、EXT. LODGE BALCONY
metadata.summary: Vultán refuses Barin's plan, deeming it suicidal, and departs despite appeals for vengeance; Flash accepts his choice and thanks him, as Zarkov interrupts with a call for a test.

document_metadata.title: 105、INT. CAPSULE
document_metadata.summary: Flash asks about the plan; Zarkov instructs him to wait for the signal 'zero' and press a button, with no questions asked.

chunks.content: (FLASH, ZARKOV) FLASH ENTERS . FLASH What's the game-plan? ZARKOV Sit there. When I give you zero, punch that button. Any questions?

metadata.title: 105、INT. CAPSULE
metadata.summary: Flash asks about the plan; Zarkov instructs him to wait for the signal 'zero' and press a button, with no questions asked.

document_metadata.title: 106、EXT. CAPSULE
document_metadata.summary: A rising hum fills the sky, shaking the earth; Lion Men and Tree Men cower, Tiger Man roars, as brown, smoking foliage rains down while everyone looks up in fear.

chunks.content: ZARKOV jumps out, leaving the door open. He crouches low. BARIN and VULTAN and EVERYBODY are watching. ZARKOV Five, four, three, two, one -- ZERO! Interior of the capsule is filled with BLINDING BLUE LIGHT for an instant. ZARKOV pops up, sticks his head in. ZARKOV (CONT'D) Flash! (NO REPLY) Do you hear me, Flash? Where are you? CU ZARKOV As INVISIBLE HANDS turn around the helmet on his head. ZARKOV (CONT'D) Eureka! I did it! You can come out now, Flash -- FLASH'S VOICE Not unless you get out of my way, I CAN'T -- BACK TO MAIN SCENE - EXT. CAPSULE ZARKOV moves inside. BARIN Look -- he still casts a shadow: It's true. FLASH is totally invisible, but on the ground we SEE his shadow as he climbs out and stands upright.

metadata.title: 106、EXT. CAPSULE
metadata.summary: A rising hum fills the sky, shaking the earth; Lion Men and Tree Men cower, Tiger Man roars, as brown, smoking foliage rains down while everyone looks up in fear.

chunks.content: Suddenly there is rising WHINING HUMMING SOUND that seems to fill the whole firmament. The earth trembles. LION MEN and TREE MEN cower in terror. TIGER MAN roars. BARIN (CONT'D) Zarkov! What have you done? . The SOUND grows louder, intolerable. Brown smoking foliage rains down. EVERYONE looks up.

metadata.title: 106、EXT. CAPSULE
metadata.summary: A rising hum fills the sky, shaking the earth; Lion Men and Tree Men cower, Tiger Man roars, as brown, smoking foliage rains down while everyone looks up in fear.

document_metadata.title: 107、EXT. FOREST OF ARBORIA
document_metadata.summary: Klytus arrives, demands Flash Gordon's location; Zarkov claims Flash is dead after being dropped by a Hawkman, while Klytus shows concern over the situation.

chunks.content: The topless forest of Arboria is withering, falling apart. Tree Men cry with primal fear as they see the sky revealed. Hovering against the sun are the dark shapes of Ming's rocket ships. Pulsing rays emanate from projectors on their bottoms. A voice booms from above: 'Prisoners of Ming, you are surrounded! The creature who moves is obliterated!' Everyone stands frozen. A lion man howls in terror and makes a break for cover, but a ray instantly zaps down, and he explodes into fiery fragments.

metadata.title: 107、EXT. FOREST OF ARBORIA
metadata.summary: Klytus arrives, demands Flash Gordon's location; Zarkov claims Flash is dead after being dropped by a Hawkman, while Klytus shows concern over the situation.

chunks.content: A small shuttle craft descends vertically and lands softly. Klytus emerges. Every sound ceases. He nods at Barin and Zarkov, then frowns as he surveys the scene. He walks directly across Flash's shadow and confronts Zarkov, demanding, 'We'll find Vultan later. Where's Flash Gordon?'Zarkov replies, 'His Hawkman dropped him. He's dead.'

metadata.title: 107、EXT. FOREST OF ARBORIA
metadata.summary: Klytus arrives, demands Flash Gordon's location; Zarkov claims Flash is dead after being dropped by a Hawkman, while Klytus shows concern over the situation.

document_metadata.title: 108、INT. MING'S SERAGLIO
document_metadata.summary: Dale comforts Aura after learning her mother was sent into space by Ming, bonding over shared grief as amazons enter.

chunks.content: Noo -- it's not true! WIDER ANGLE. AURA (GENTLY) It is -- they saw him fall a mile into the glaciers of Frigia. DALE shuts her eyes, sobs out: DALE Oh Flash -- no -- you can't be dead -- it doesn't make any sense -- AURA When I think of being given to Klytus, I wish it was myself who had fallen. DALE (blazing at her) I don't believe you. You -- you awful Mongo person -- you were born without a heart: AURA Then what is it that melts into my eyes, Dale Arden? Feel it breaking -- Tear runs down AURA'S cheeks. She seizes DALE'S hand, presses it against her wonderful breast. DALE is really moved.

metadata.title: 108、INT. MING'S SERAGLIO
metadata.summary: Dale comforts Aura after learning her mother was sent into space by Ming, bonding over shared grief as amazons enter.

chunks.content: DALE You poor kid -- don't you have a MOM to talk to? AURA Ming tired of her. He blew my Mother into outer space. I look into the night sky sometimes and wonder what star she's orbiting -- DALE God, Aura -- no wonder you've had problems -- that bastard: DALE embraces AURA. They cling to each other, bosom against bosom, in perfect womanly understanding. Golden CHORDS are heard.Doors open. AMAZONS enter.

metadata.title: 108、INT. MING'S SERAGLIO
metadata.summary: Dale comforts Aura after learning her mother was sent into space by Ming, bonding over shared grief as amazons enter.

document_metadata.summary: Flash enters the capsule in a desolate launch-gantry after a ray attack, with no one else present.

chunks.content: Capsule sits in its launch-gantry, amidst the ruined blight left by the ray attack. There is not a soul in sight. Then Flash's SHADOW moves quickly over the ground toward the Capsule and VANISHES into the hatch. The door shuts itself. .

chunks.content: Control levers move. A red button depresses itself. Through the side, which we should remember is transparent from within, we SEE the scene outside going into a GREEN-BROWN BLUR as the capsule starts to spin for takeoff.

document_metadata.summary: Ming is interrupted by Klytus, who senses danger and predicts an Earthling capsule appearing on the scanner in one minute before disappearing into shadow.

chunks.content: (KLYTUS, MING) MING is being robed by TWO GIRL ATTENDANTS. Suddenly KLYTUS is there in a shadow, smiling. MING senses him, turns. MING Well? What is it this time? KLYTUS I can't remember. I feel danger -- but I cannot see it. MING Klytus, you're impossible. Aura deserves you. KLYTUS I foresee another thing. In one minute exactly, the Earthling space capsule will be seen on the scanner. KLYTUS is swallowed again in shadow.

chunks.content: VULTAN and some other HAWKMEN perch silently, listening to a VOICE emanating from a radio on VULTAN'S belt. FLASH'S VOICE calls out, 'Flash Gordon calling Vultan! Over!' VULTAN remains motionless, not even a feather stirring. After a pause, Flash continues, acknowledging Vultan's silence: 'Okay, don't answer -- I'm on Hawkman frequency, I know you are reading me. Now get this -- CAPSULE AND TREE IN ARBORIA.'

chunks.content: Intercuts follow as Flash's voice persists, guiding them: 'I'm being guided through the force-field under their control. Flash presses on, 'Okay, Vultan, it's your decision -- the ball is in your court. I hope I'll be seeing you, you crazy ole bird.' The microphone lowers itself back onto the panel, ending the transmission.VULTAN and his HAWKMEN remain seated, grim-faced and unmoving. VULTAN slowly shakes his head, finally breaking the silence with a quiet remark: 'He calls us crazy --'

document_metadata.title: 116、EXT. PALACE BATTLEMENTS
document_metadata.summary: The capsule is empty, prompting Klytus to order its destruction. Flash Invisible, unseen, witnesses the loss of his return vessel and flees into the compound for cover.

chunks.content: It's an armed camp. SOLDIERS stand amidst tanks and ray-gun artillery, every weapon trained on a landing pad in the middle. KLYTUS waits with his CAPTAIN, watching the mirror-bright capsule descending through the atmosphere. It lands with a soft thud. The CAPTAIN gives a signal, and instantly, ZAP! A tank's ray gun fires, knocking the capsule's door off its hinges with surgical precision. Flanked by SOLDIERS holding charged ray-guns, the CAPTAIN cautiously advances, peers inside, then turns in surprise to call out to KLYTUS.

metadata.title: 116、EXT. PALACE BATTLEMENTS
metadata.summary: The capsule is empty, prompting Klytus to order its destruction. Flash Invisible, unseen, witnesses the loss of his return vessel and flees into the compound for cover.

chunks.content: GUARD CAPTAIN: It's empty! KLYTUS, stunned, demands an explanation. The GUARD CAPTAIN replies that the capsule must have been unmanned, launched on some automatic program. KLYTUS frowns, deep in thought, failing to notice the SHADOW that suddenly passes over him and moves swiftly away. Without hesitation, he orders: Destroy it. At his command, a ray gun mounted on a tank fires, engulfing ZARKOV'S CAPSULE in a flash of energy until it glows white-hot and crumbles into thin ashes.FLASH INVISIBLE lets out a bitter sigh, witnessing the destruction of his only means of return. The SHADOW shifts again—FLASH halts in dismay, then quickly regains composure as his silhouette darts toward an open doorway, seeking cover and concealment within the fortress-like compound.

metadata.title: 116、EXT. PALACE BATTLEMENTS
metadata.summary: The capsule is empty, prompting Klytus to order its destruction. Flash Invisible, unseen, witnesses the loss of his return vessel and flees into the compound for cover.

chunks.content: (FLASH' S VOICE, SOLDIER) Stands on guard. Suddenly out of nowhere, but very close. FLASH' S VOICE Which way to the dungeons, Soldier: SOLDIER Third elevator down, turn left! (then doing a take) Who is that? . WHAM! A left to the gut doubles him over to take an invisible knockout right on the chin.

chunks.content: (FLASH'S VOICE) TWO SOLDIERS stand with ray-guns before a heavy locked door. Suddenly INVISIBLE FLASH steps behind a flaring torch, casting an enormous SHADOW on the wall. He manipulates his caped arms so that the image becomes truly fearsome. FLASH'S VOICE I am the ghost of all the good men murdered by Ming! Prepare for doom! The SOLDIERS faint.

chunks.content: FOUR SOLDIERS march along, two by two, filling the narrow way. SOUND OF RUNNING FEET coming towards them. They halt i n consternation. WHAM! Invisible FLASH crashes into them, sending them flying like bowling-pins.

chunks.content: (GUARD) FOUR GUARDS lounge. around. MOVE to one of them, who sits studying the pictures in the Mingo version of PLAYBOY magazine. A SHADOW falls over the page. GUARD I'm looking at it now -- wait for your turn. An INVISIBLE UPPERCUT knocks him off his chair. ANGLES - THE FIGHT As INVISIBLE FLASH goes after the other three with a deadly chair that seems to SWING itself through the air.

chunks.content: (FLASH'S VOICE) ZARKOV, BARIN and TIGER MAN lie in chains, heads cocked at SOUNDS of the facas outside. THUD of a body falling, brief silence, then sound of a KEY IN THE LOCK. The door opens itself. FLASH'S VOICE It's me! .

document_metadata.summary: Barin, Zarkov, Tiger Man, and Flash climb a shaft on Mongo; Flash and Barin are partially invisible. They discuss reaching the plasma level via an anti-gravity shaft.

chunks.content: (BARIN, FLASH'S VOICE, ZARKOV) The Same one AURA and FLASH fell down originally. Now BARIN, ZARKOV, TIGER MAN and FLASH are inching their way UP it like mountain climbers doing a rock chimney; in. back-to-back pairs, feet pressed out against the shaft walls. What makes it look even stranger, half of the FLASH-BARIN twosome is INVISIBLE. Low conversation as they pant and struggle up the SHAFT: ZARKOV How do we get down to the plasma level? FLASH'S VOICE Anti-gravity shaft -- I got a guard to show me -- BARIN This won't be easy, Flash -- FLASH'S VOICE Nothing's easy on Mongo --

document_metadata.title: 123、INT. PLASMA CAVERN
document_metadata.summary: Slaves suffer under torture to fuel a reactor as the needle rises; eyes watch from a hidden window, signaling unseen overseers monitoring the operation to destroy Earth for Dale Arden's wedding.

chunks.content: (CONTROLLER, GUARD CAPTAIN) LIZARD MEN SLAVES work like mad, shoveling radioactive fuel into the seething mass. ON THE MEZZANINE CONTROLLERS are at consoles. Many GUARDS stand around. Everyone watches a big hanging dial. Its needle quivers with each flare-up from the inferno below, inches toward a RED SECTOR. GUARD CAPTAIN Faster! -- More fueld! CONTROLLER What's the hurry? CONTROLLER What's the hurry? GUARD CAPTAIN He wants to give Dale Arden the final destruction of Earth as a wedding present.

metadata.title: 123、INT. PLASMA CAVERN
metadata.summary: Slaves suffer under torture to fuel a reactor as the needle rises; eyes watch from a hidden window, signaling unseen overseers monitoring the operation to destroy Earth for Dale Arden's wedding.

chunks.content: CONTROLLERS twist the shock-knobs. Tortured SLAVES howl in agony. Some drop and are thrown into the fiery mass, others redouble their efforts. ON THE MEZZANINE The needle quivers upwards. MOVE OFF it to a slot-like window in back wall. There are EYES behind the glass.

metadata.title: 123、INT. PLASMA CAVERN
metadata.summary: Slaves suffer under torture to fuel a reactor as the needle rises; eyes watch from a hidden window, signaling unseen overseers monitoring the operation to destroy Earth for Dale Arden's wedding.

document_metadata.title: 124、INT. CRAWLSPACE BEHIND THE MEZZANINE
document_metadata.summary: Barin, Zarkov, and Tiger Man observe a critical plasma contraction threatening Earth; Flash reports all exits sealed, leaving them hopeless without a miracle.

chunks.content: (BARIN, FLASH'S VOICE, TIGER MAN, ZARKOV) ZARKOV,BARIN and TIGER MAN crouch amidst WHIRRING ventilators, watching through the window. BARIN How's it look to yoU? ZARKOV Bad. Plasma's contracting into a critical mass. When that needle hits the red, Earth is finished. TIGER MAN Grrao! I'll charge down at them: ZARKOV and BARIN just look at him. TIGER MAN slumps out of his fighting stance. Low door at the back opens itself and INVISIBLE FLASH comes in. FLASH'S VOICE Cavern is sealed tight -- every door locked from the inside -- CU ZARKOV Hope drains from his expression. ZARKOV Let's face it, my friends -- without a miracle, we've lost.

metadata.title: 124、INT. CRAWLSPACE BEHIND THE MEZZANINE
metadata.summary: Barin, Zarkov, and Tiger Man observe a critical plasma contraction threatening Earth; Flash reports all exits sealed, leaving them hopeless without a miracle.

document_metadata.title: 125、EXT. SKY - WIDE ANGLE
document_metadata.summary: Hawkmen led by Vultan and his captain fly toward Mingo, diving through a narrow force-field pass; all press on despite danger, prompting reflection on Earth's worth.

chunks.content: (HAWKMAN CAPTAIN, VULTAN) It is filled with HAWKMEN, flying toward us. VULTAN and HIS CAPTAIN. fly in the lead, looking ahead and down at the City of Mingo. HAWKMAN CAPTAIN All right -- I see the towers lined up now as Flash Gordon said -- VULTAN soars up and hovers, shouts to the ranks behind: . VULTAN Through the force-field, my Hawkmen! The pass is narrow -- dive three-by- three! Any man who wishes to turn back may do so! THE HAWKMEN Keep flying right on, not one bird of them turning back. FEATURE VULTAN Musing to his captain: VULTAN (CONT'D) Who are these Earthlings, that so many would die for? HAWKMAN CAPTAIN They must have one hell of a little PLANET --

document_metadata.summary: Hawkmen battle soldiers in a chaotic fight involving swords, ray-guns, and spears. Vultan fights fiercely, saved when an enemy trips mysteriously, and is aided by an invisible ally.

chunks.content: HAWKMEN descend as SOLDIERS rush out at them. The battle is epic, a crazy combination of swords and ray-guns and clubs and spears. VULTAN is a towering figure in the middle of it, dealing havoc on all sides. As he fights THREE SOLDIERS, ANOTHER races at VULTAN'S back with a deadly spear. document_metadata.title: 134、INT. A PALACE ANTECHAMBER
document_metadata.summary: Ming, preparing for his wedding, dismisses an officer's warning of a Hawkmen attack, asserting Mingo City's invulnerability and refusing to delay the ceremony.

chunks.content: (KLYTUS, MING, OFFICER) MING and KLYTUS, in ceremonial robes. As part of his costume MING wears a sword. MING You have the ring? KLYTUS In my pocket. Door flies open, an OFFICER dashes in. OFFICER Your Majesty, we're under attack by Hawkmen! MING So what are you doing down here, coward? Why aren't you in the fray? OFFICER Sire, I thought you'd -- MING Mingo City is impregnable! I'm not about to put off wedding Dale Arden for this!

FLASH'S VOICE The cavern first! Gotta get Zarkov in there to -- Suddenly MUSIC is heard from below. Some great electronic organ booms out the strains of what is recognizably "Here Come The Bride".... the familiar thrilling wedding-march. FLASH'S VOICE (CONT'D) On my god! .

chunks.content: Earth turns slowly in mid-air, its seas and continents veiled by clouds of hideous smoke which seethe with flashes of interior red lightning. Then FACES come INTO FOCUS below and behind it, and we realise we are in MING'S GREAT HALL, where EARTH is a holographic image in a transparent box above the altar-throne. FEATURE DALE Standing beside MING at the altar with KLYTUS, looking up despairingly at her beloved planet while the HIGH PRIEST INTONES: HIGH PRIEST Do you take her, this Earthling, Dale Arden, to be your Empress of the hour? Do you solemnly promise to use her as you will -- not discard her until such time as you grow weary of her? MING I do. HIGH PRIEST The wedding ring, please -- KLYTUS produces a golden ring, hands it to MING. MING takes DALE'S left hand, forces it up into position, holds the ring poised to slip it on. MING'S face has never been more merciless. HIGH PRIEST (CONT'D) Recite after me -- with this ring I thee wed --

chunks.content: FLASH'S VOICE With this ring, I thee wed! An INVISIBLE HAND snatches the ring from MING'S grip like lightning and jams it onto DALE'S finger. DALE Flash!!! FLASH'S VOICE Run!!! HIGH ANGLE . Pandemonium. DALE runs like hell, but is tripped by her train and goes down as MING leaps up onto his throne platform. MING Seal this hall! Close every portal! ANGLE - A PORTAL Swinging shut, BARIN squeezing in through it at the last instant, sword in hand. KLYTUS rushes at him with a sword of his own. MING Looks around wildly, whipping out the sword sheathed at his belt. Its blade is like crystal fire. He reacts sharply, catches his breath. WHAT MING SEES - ANOTHER SWORD (FLASH'S VOICE, MING) exactly like his, a blade of fire, apparently hanging in the air and pointed right at him. MING Where did you get that sword? FLASH'S VOICE From the crystal block. MING Impossible! It could only be pulled by my rightful heir! FLASH'S VOICE How about that? The sword slowly advances. FEATURE MING His face contorted, he flies at INVISIBLE FLASH behind the sword. FLASH parries the blow. Astonishing pyrotechnics as the blades hit each other. Shrieking MONGONS flee under showers of fire.

document_metadata.title: 143、INT. GREAT HALL
document_metadata.summary: Klytus reveals a monstrous face, duels Barin, but is killed by Aura stabbing him from behind. Barin and Aura embrace. Flash and Ming continue fighting on a statue's shoulder near a giant ear.

chunks.content: Ming and Flash duel dazzlingly around the enormous throne, their movements swift and intense. Suddenly, Flash begins to lose his invisibility—eyes appear, the tip of a nose, fragments of limbs become visible. Dale, pinned by Amazons, reacts with alarm: 'Flash—look out—you're coming back! He can see you now, Flash!' Flash pauses momentarily to glance at himself, nearly losing his head to a fiery slash from Ming. He recovers quickly, bounding higher up the vast throne statue where the battle rages. In the foreground, the image of Earth slowly turns, glowing redder as lightning flickers within its clouds, signaling rising danger. Meanwhile, Barin and Klytus clash in another part of the hall. Barin lands a thrust on Klytus’s forehead, causing blood to gush down over his eyes.

metadata.title: 143、INT. GREAT HALL
metadata.summary: Klytus reveals a monstrous face, duels Barin, but is killed by Aura stabbing him from behind. Barin and Aura embrace. Flash and Ming continue fighting on a statue's shoulder near a giant ear.

chunks.content: Klytus stumbles back, declaring he foresaw the blow. Barin demands he drop his sword, claiming he’s blinded. But Klytus laughs, throws off his helmet, and whirls with lightning speed to reveal a second, grotesque face—shadowed, hideous, marked by pure evil, letting out a raging scream. Barin lunges in horror, slashing at the monstrous visage. His blade cuts Klytus’s cheek, but the wound doesn’t bleed. They fly at each other again, exchanging fierce blows until each seizes the other’s wrist with a free hand. Klytus mocks Barin, insisting he cannot foresee his death at Barin’s hands. With a sudden twist, Klytus knocks Barin’s sword away and drives him back against the wall, raising his own blade for the killing thrust—when his face contorts in shock.Pulling back, we see Aura behind Klytus, her hand on the hilt of Barin’s sword, which she has driven into Klytus’s back. Soundlessly, Klytus collapses, dead. Aura and Barin move together, embracing tightly. Barin gently touches her face; AURA strokes his cheek in a deeply human, loving gesture. Meanwhile, Flash and Ming continue their duel, now having climbed all the way onto the shoulder of the great statue, fighting precariously against a massive replica of Ming’s ear.

document_metadata.title: 145、INT. GREAT HALL
document_metadata.summary: Flash defeats Ming, who disintegrates without bloodshed; Flash is hailed as a hero by Amazons and Mongons alike in a unifying moment of victory and acclaim.

chunks.content: CU DALE, reacting to something and pointing upward: 'Look -- Earth! Earth!' The image of Earth appears in the air, breathtaking and distant. Dale's voice trembles with awe: 'Oh, it's so beautiful!' The moment of wonder is shared across the room, a brief pause in the chaos as all eyes turn toward the vision of home, suspended in the air like a promise of return.

metadata.title: 145、INT. GREAT HALL
metadata.summary: Flash defeats Ming, who disintegrates without bloodshed; Flash is hailed as a hero by Amazons and Mongons alike in a unifying moment of victory and acclaim.

chunks.content: FEATURE MING as he swivels his head for a quick look at the image. His expression shifts instantly to unmitigated rage. In a flash, Flash seizes the moment and thrusts his sword into Ming up to the hilt. He pulls it out just as quickly—but there's no blood. Ming stands frozen, then begins to smoke violently, disintegrating into the very atoms from which he was constituted. In spectacular fashion, Ming is simply gone.HIGH SHOT - THE GREAT HALL. Everyone looks upwards at Flash, standing with his sword atop the statue, victorious and silhouetted against the light. There is a clatter as the Amazons cast away their spears. A single cry rises from every throat: 'Hail, Flash Gordon!' The Mongons echo the chant, their allegiance shifting in unison as the hall erupts in acclamation.

document_metadata.title: 147、EXT. PALACE BATTLEMENTS
document_metadata.summary: Flash, Dale, and Zarkov reflect on saving Earth; Dale mourns losing their return capsule, but Zarkov declares they are home. Flash and Dale embrace, then head to the palace for their honeymoon.

chunks.content: (DALE, FLASH, ZARKOV) It is a scene of peace now. HAWKMEN and SOLDIERS join in tending their wounded. Formerly fierce AMAZONS act as gentle nurses. MOVE OVER this to find FLASH, DALE and ZARKOV standing together, looking up at the terrific sky-shadow, FLASH with an arm around DALE'S shoulder. He glances at her tenderly, is surprised to see tears on her cheeks. FLASH What's the matter, darling? DALE We saved Earth but we lost the capsule -- we'll never get home again. . ZARKOV (SIMPLY) You are home. FLASH Zarkov is right. ZARKOV Shouldn't you fellows be leaving on your honeymoon? DALE laughs, turns her face up to FLASH. He kisses her. As they head into the Palace, ZARKOV gazes upward again.
